kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ kurvīta viprasyotpādya śoṇitaṃ /
:n
1 na yujyeteti kha..
2 kṛcchrair viśuddhyati iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
3 naroṣṭaviḍvarāhaiśceti ṅa..
4 krūṅkāramiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / oṅkāramiti ga.. , ṅa.. ca /
haṅkārañceti kha..
:p 176
cāṇḍālādiravijñāto yasya tiṣṭheta veśmani //
170.d:
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रं कुर्वीत विप्रस्योत्पाद्य शोणितं /
:न्
1 न युज्येतेति ख..
2 कृच्छ्रैर् विशुद्ध्यति इति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
3 नरोष्टविड्वराहैश्चेति ङ..
4 क्रूङ्कारमिति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. च / ओङ्कारमिति ग.. , ङ.. च /
हङ्कारञ्चेति ख..
:प् 176
चाण्डालादिरविज्ञातो यस्य तिष्ठेत वेश्मनि //
170.m:
causing the blood of a vipra to flow, he should perform a kṛcchrātikṛcchra.
[Footnote]
1. 'na yujyeta' in manuscript kha.
2. 'kṛcchrair viśuddhyati' in manuscripts ga, gha, and ṅa.
3. 'naroṣṭraviḍvarāhaiśca' in manuscript ṅa.
4. 'krūṅkāram' in manuscripts kha, gha, and cha; 'oṅkāram' in ga and ṅa; 'haṅkārañca' in kha. / [p. 176]
If an unrecognised cāṇḍāla or similar person should reside in someone's dwelling,

170.s:
samyag jñātastu kālena tasya kurvīta śodhanaṃ /
cāndrāyaṇaṃ parākaṃ vā dvijānāntu viśodhanaṃ //
170.d:
सम्यग् ज्ञातस्तु कालेन तस्य कुर्वीत शोधनं /
चान्द्रायणं पराकं वा द्विजानान्तु विशोधनं //
170.m: when fully recognised in time, one should perform a purification for it: / a cāndrāyaṇa or a parāka is the purification for twice-born men;

170.s:
prājāpatyantu śūdrāṇāṃ śeṣantadanusārataḥ /
guṃḍaṅkusumbhaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā dhānyāni yāni ca //
170.d:
प्राजापत्यन्तु शूद्राणां शेषन्तदनुसारतः /
गुंडङ्कुसुम्भं लवणं तथा धान्यानि यानि च //
170.m: a prājāpatya for śūdras; the rest [should be done] accordingly. / Molasses, safflower, salt, and whatever grains [are there],

170.s:
kṛtvā gṛhe tato dvāri teṣāndadyāddhutāśanaṃ /
mṛṇamayānāntu bhāṇḍānāṃ tyāga eva vidhīyate //
170.d:
कृत्वा गृहे ततो द्वारि तेषान्दद्याद्धुताशनं /
मृणमयानान्तु भाण्डानां त्याग एव विधीयते //
170.m: having placed [them] at the doorway of that house, one should set fire to them. / The abandonment of earthen vessels is prescribed.

170.s:
dravyāṇāṃ pariśeṣāṇāṃ dravyaśuddhirvidhīyate /
kūpaikapānasaktā ye sparśātsaṅkalpadūṣitāḥ(1) //
170.d:
द्रव्याणां परिशेषाणां द्रव्यशुद्धिर्विधीयते /
कूपैकपानसक्ता ये स्पर्शात्सङ्कल्पदूषिताः(1) //
170.m: For the remaining materials, purification of objects is prescribed. / Those who are attached to drinking from a single well, corrupted in resolve through contact,

170.s:
śuddhyeyurupavāsena pañcagavyena vāpyatha /
yastu saṃspṛśya caṇḍālamaśnīyācca svakāmataḥ //
170.d:
शुद्ध्येयुरुपवासेन पञ्चगव्येन वाप्यथ /
यस्तु संस्पृश्य चण्डालमश्नीयाच्च स्वकामतः //
170.m: become pure by a fast or by the five products of the cow (pañcagavya). / One who intentionally touches a caṇḍāla and eats,

170.s:
dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāttaptakṛcchramathāpi vā /
bhāṇḍasaṅkalasaṅkīrṇaścāṇḍālādijugupsitaiḥ //
170.d:
द्विजश्चान्द्रायणं कुर्यात्तप्तकृच्छ्रमथापि वा /
भाण्डसङ्कलसङ्कीर्णश्चाण्डालादिजुगुप्सितैः //
170.m: if twice-born, should perform a cāndrāyaṇa or a taptakṛcchra. / One who is contaminated through vessels [held in common] with despised persons such as cāṇḍālas,

170.s:
bhuktvāpītvā tathā teṣāṃ ṣaḍrātreṇa viśuddhyati /
antyānāṃ bhuktaśeṣantu bhakṣayitvā dvijātayaḥ //
170.d:
भुक्त्वापीत्वा तथा तेषां षड्रात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति /
अन्त्यानां भुक्तशेषन्तु भक्षयित्वा द्विजातयः //
170.m: having eaten or drunk their [food and drink], becomes purified after six nights. / Twice-born men having eaten the leftover food of outcasts

170.s:
vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryustrirātraṃ śūdra eva tu /
caṇḍālakūpabhāṇḍeṣu ajñānātpivate jalaṃ //
170.d:
व्रतं चान्द्रायणं कुर्युस्त्रिरात्रं शूद्र एव तु /
चण्डालकूपभाण्डेषु अज्ञानात्पिवते जलं //
170.m: should observe the cāndrāyaṇa votive observance, but a śūdra [fasts for] three nights. / If out of ignorance he drinks water from a caṇḍāla's well or vessels,

170.s:
dvijaḥ śāntapanaṃ kuryācchūdraścopavaseddinaṃ /
caṇḍālena tu saṃspṛṣṭo(2) yastvapaḥ pivate dvijaḥ //
170.d:
द्विजः शान्तपनं कुर्याच्छूद्रश्चोपवसेद्दिनं /
चण्डालेन तु संस्पृष्टो(2) यस्त्वपः पिवते द्विजः //
170.m: a twice-born man should perform the śāntapana penance, and a śūdra should fast for a day. / But a twice-born man who, touched by a caṇḍāla, drinks water,

170.s:
trirātrantena kartavyaṃ śūdraścopavaseddinaṃ /
ucchiṣṭena yadi(3) spṛṣṭaḥ śunā śūdreṇa vā dvijaḥ //
:n
1 sparśasaṅkalpabhūṣitā iti jha..
2 saṃsṛṣṭa iti ka..
3 yadeti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
:p 177
170.d:
त्रिरात्रन्तेन कर्तव्यं शूद्रश्चोपवसेद्दिनं /
उच्छिष्टेन यदि(3) स्पृष्टः शुना शूद्रेण वा द्विजः //
:न्
1 स्पर्शसङ्कल्पभूषिता इति झ..
2 संसृष्ट इति क..
3 यदेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
:प् 177
170.m:
must observe [a penance of] three nights, and a śūdra should fast for a day. / If a twice-born man is touched by a dog or a śūdra while defiled by food,
[Footnote]
1. 'sparśasaṅkalpabhūṣitāḥ' in manuscript jha.
2. 'saṃsṛṣṭaḥ' in manuscript ka.
3. 'yadā' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and cha. / [p. 177]

170.s:
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ pañcagavyena śuddhyati /
vaiśyena kṣatriyeṇaiva snānaṃ naktaṃ samācaret //
170.d:
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति /
वैश्येन क्षत्रियेणैव स्नानं नक्तं समाचरेत् //
170.m: having fasted for one night, he is purified by the five products of the cow. / With a vaiśya or a kṣatriya [similarly defiled], he should take a bath and eat only at night.

170.s:
adhvānaṃ prasthito vipraḥ kāntāre yadyanūdake /
pakvānnena gṛhītena mūtroccāraṅkaroti vai //
170.d:
अध्वानं प्रस्थितो विप्रः कान्तारे यद्यनूदके /
पक्वान्नेन गृहीतेन मूत्रोच्चारङ्करोति वै //
170.m: If a vipra setting out on a journey in a waterless wilderness / discharges urine or feces while holding cooked food,

170.s:
anidhāyaiva taddravyaṃ aṅge kṛtvā tu saṃsthitaṃ /
śaucaṃ kṛtvānnamabhyukṣya arkasyāgneyaś ca darśayet //
170.d:
अनिधायैव तद्द्रव्यं अङ्गे कृत्वा तु संस्थितं /
शौचं कृत्वान्नमभ्युक्ष्य अर्कस्याग्नेयश् च दर्शयेत् //
170.m: without setting that item down but keeping it on his body, / having performed ritual purification and sprinkled the food with water, he should show it to the sun and fire.

170.s:
mlecchair gatānāṃ caurair vā kāntāre vā pravāsināṃ /
bhakṣyābhakṣyaviśuddhyarthaṃ(1) teṣāṃ vakṣyāminiṣkṛtiṃ //
170.d:
म्लेच्छैर् गतानां चौरैर् वा कान्तारे वा प्रवासिनां /
भक्ष्याभक्ष्यविशुद्ध्यर्थं(1) तेषां वक्ष्यामिनिष्कृतिं //
170.m: For those taken by barbarians (mlecchas) or thieves, or dwelling abroad in the wilderness, / I shall proclaim an expiation for the purification of edible and inedible things.

170.s:
punaḥ prāpya svadeśañca varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ /
kṛcchrasyānte brāhmaṇastu punaḥ saṃskāramarhati //
170.d:
पुनः प्राप्य स्वदेशञ्च वर्णानामनुपूर्वशः /
कृच्छ्रस्यान्ते ब्राह्मणस्तु पुनः संस्कारमर्हति //
170.m: Having returned again to their own land, in the order of the social classes: / at the end of a kṛcchra, a brāhmaṇa is entitled to undergo sacraments again;

170.s:
pādonānte kṣatriyaś ca ardhānte vaiśya eva ca /
pādaṃ kṛtvā tathā śūdro dānaṃ datvā viśuddhyati //
170.d:
पादोनान्ते क्षत्रियश् च अर्धान्ते वैश्य एव च /
पादं कृत्वा तथा शूद्रो दानं दत्वा विशुद्ध्यति //
170.m: a kṣatriya at the end of three-quarters [of a kṛcchra]; a vaiśya at the end of half; / and having performed one quarter and given a gift, a śūdra becomes purified.

170.s:
udakyā tu savarṇā yā spṛṣṭā cet syādudakyayā /
tasminnevāhani snātā śuddhimāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ //
170.d:
उदक्या तु सवर्णा या स्पृष्टा चेत् स्यादुदक्यया /
तस्मिन्नेवाहनि स्नाता शुद्धिमाप्नोत्यसंशयं //
170.m: If a menstruating woman is touched by a menstruating woman of the same caste, / having bathed on that very day, she attains ritual purity without doubt.

170.s:
rajasvalā tu nāśnīyāt saṃspṛṣṭā hīnavarṇayā /
yāvanna śuddhimāpnoti śuddhasnānena śuddhyati //
170.d:
रजस्वला तु नाश्नीयात् संस्पृष्टा हीनवर्णया /
यावन्न शुद्धिमाप्नोति शुद्धस्नानेन शुद्ध्यति //
170.m: A menstruating woman touched by a woman of lower caste should not eat / until she attains ritual purity; she is purified by a purifying bath.

170.s:
mūtraṃ kṛtvā vrajanvartma smṛtibhraṃśājjalaṃ pivet /
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śuddhyati //
170.d:
मूत्रं कृत्वा व्रजन्वर्त्म स्मृतिभ्रंशाज्जलं पिवेत् /
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति //
170.m: If after urinating while walking on the road one drinks water through lapse of memory, / having fasted for a day and night, he is purified by the five products of the cow.

170.s:
mūtroccāraṃ dvijaḥ kṛtvā akṛtvā śaucamātmanaḥ /
mohādbhuktvā(2) trirātrantu yavān pītvā viśuddhyati //
170.d:
मूत्रोच्चारं द्विजः कृत्वा अकृत्वा शौचमात्मनः /
मोहाद्भुक्त्वा(2) त्रिरात्रन्तु यवान् पीत्वा विशुद्ध्यति //
170.m: If a twice-born man discharges urine or feces and, without performing his ritual purification, / eats out of delusion, he is purified by drinking barley-water for three nights.

170.s:
ye pratyavasitā viprāḥ pravrajyādibalāttathā /
:n
1 bhakṣyabhojyaviśuddhyarthamiti jha..
2 lobhādbhuktveti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
:p 178
anāśakanivṛtāś ca teṣāṃ śuddhiḥ pracakṣyate //
170.d:
ये प्रत्यवसिता विप्राः प्रव्रज्यादिबलात्तथा /
:न्
1 भक्ष्यभोज्यविशुद्ध्यर्थमिति झ..
2 लोभाद्भुक्त्वेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
:प् 178
अनाशकनिवृताश् च तेषां शुद्धिः प्रचक्ष्यते //
170.m:
For those vipras who have lapsed from religious mendicancy and the like by force
[Footnote]
1. 'bhakṣyabhojyaviśuddhyartham' in manuscript jha.
2. 'lobhādbhuktvā' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and cha. / [p. 178]
and for those turned back from fasting to death, purification is proclaimed:

170.s:
cārayettrīṇi kṛcchrāṇi cāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā /
jātakarmādisaṃskāraiḥ saṃskuryāttaṃ tathā punaḥ //
170.d:
चारयेत्त्रीणि कृच्छ्राणि चान्द्रायणमथापि वा /
जातकर्मादिसंस्कारैः संस्कुर्यात्तं तथा पुनः //
170.m: one should make them perform three kṛcchras or a cāndrāyaṇa, / and should consecrate them again with the life-cycle sacraments beginning with the birth rite (jātakarman).

170.s:
upānahamamedhyaṃ ca yasya saṃspṛśate mukhaṃ /
mṛttikāgomayau tatra pañcagavyañca śodhanaṃ //
170.d:
उपानहममेध्यं च यस्य संस्पृशते मुखं /
मृत्तिकागोमयौ तत्र पञ्चगव्यञ्च शोधनं //
170.m: When a shoe or impure matter touches someone's face, / clay, cow dung, and the five products of the cow are the purification there.

170.s:
vāpanaṃ vikrayañcaiva nīlavastrādidhāraṇaṃ /
tapanīyaṃ hi viprasya tribhiḥ kṛchrair viśuddhyati //
170.d:
वापनं विक्रयञ्चैव नीलवस्त्रादिधारणं /
तपनीयं हि विप्रस्य त्रिभिः कृछ्रैर् विशुद्ध्यति //
170.m: Shaving [for money], selling, wearing blue garments, and the like, / are indeed a torment for a vipra; he is purified by three kṛcchras.

170.s:
antyajātiśvapākena(1) saṃspṛṣṭā strī rajasvalā /
caturthe 'hani śuddhā sā trirātraṃ tatra ācaret(2) //
170.d:
अन्त्यजातिश्वपाकेन(1) संस्पृष्टा स्त्री रजस्वला /
चतुर्थे ऽहनि शुद्धा सा त्रिरात्रं तत्र आचरेत्(2) //
170.m: A menstruating woman touched by an outcaste or dog-cooker / is purified on the fourth day; she should observe [a penance of] three nights therein.

170.s:
cāṇḍālaśvapacau spṛṣṭvā tathā pūyañca sūtikāṃ /
śavaṃ tatsparśinaṃ spṛṣṭvā(3) sadyaḥ snānena śuddhyati //
170.d:
चाण्डालश्वपचौ स्पृष्ट्वा तथा पूयञ्च सूतिकां /
शवं तत्स्पर्शिनं स्पृष्ट्वा(3) सद्यः स्नानेन शुद्ध्यति //
170.m: Having touched a caṇḍāla, a dog-cooker, or pus, or a woman in childbed, / or a corpse or one who touched it, one is instantly purified by a bath.

170.s:
nāraṃ spṛṣṭvāsthi sasnehaṃ snātvā vipro viśuddhyati /
rathyārkaddamatoyena adhīnābhermṛdodakaiḥ //
170.d:
नारं स्पृष्ट्वास्थि सस्नेहं स्नात्वा विप्रो विशुद्ध्यति /
रथ्यार्कद्दमतोयेन अधीनाभेर्मृदोदकैः //
170.m: Having touched a human bone with fat, a vipra is purified by bathing. / [Touched by] road dust, mud, or water below the navel, [one is purified] by earth and water.

170.s:
vānto viviktaḥ snātvā tu ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati /
snānāt kṣurakarmakartā kṛcchrakṛdgrahaṇe 'nnabhuk //
170.d:
वान्तो विविक्तः स्नात्वा तु घृतं प्राश्य विशुद्ध्यति /
स्नानात् क्षुरकर्मकर्ता कृच्छ्रकृद्ग्रहणे ऽन्नभुक् //
170.m: One who has vomited or purged becomes pure after bathing and sipping clarified butter. / One who has shaved becomes pure through bathing; one who has eaten during an eclipse must perform a kṛcchra.

170.s:
apāṅkteyāśī gavyāśī śunā daṣṭas tathā śuciḥ /
kṛmidaṣṭaścātmaghātī kṛcchrājjapyācca homataḥ //
170.d:
अपाङ्क्तेयाशी गव्याशी शुना दष्टस् तथा शुचिः /
कृमिदष्टश्चात्मघाती कृच्छ्राज्जप्याच्च होमतः //
170.m: One who eats with outcasts, one who consumes cow products, or one bitten by a dog becomes pure in that way; / one bitten by worms and one who attempted suicide [become pure] through kṛcchra, recitation, and fire oblation.

170.s:
homādyaiścānutāpena pūyante pāpino 'khilāḥ(4) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe prāyaścittāni nāma saptatyadhikaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 antyajaiś ca svapākeneti ṅa.
2 antyajātiśvapākenetyādiḥ, tatra ācaredityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha..
pustake nāsti
3 śavantatatsparśinaṃ śvānamiti kha.. / śavantatspṛṣṭinaṃ
śvānamiti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 mūtroccāraṃ dvijaḥ kṛtvetyādiḥ, pūyante pāpino 'khilā ity
antaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. , jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 179
:ś atha ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāyaścittāni
170.d:
होमाद्यैश्चानुतापेन पूयन्ते पापिनो ऽखिलाः(4) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रायश्चित्तानि नाम सप्तत्यधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 अन्त्यजैश् च स्वपाकेनेति ङ.
2 अन्त्यजातिश्वपाकेनेत्यादिः, तत्र आचरेदित्यन्तः पाठः छ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
3 शवन्ततत्स्पर्शिनं श्वानमिति ख.. / शवन्तत्स्पृष्टिनं
श्वानमिति घ.. , ज.. च
4 मूत्रोच्चारं द्विजः कृत्वेत्यादिः, पूयन्ते पापिनो ऽखिला इत्य्
अन्तः पाठः ज.. , झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 179
:श् अथ एकसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रायश्चित्तानि
170.m:
And through fire oblations and the like, as well as through repentance, all sinners are purified.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventieth chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, named 'Expiations'.
1 'antyajaiś ca svapākeneti' in manuscript ṅa.
2 The passage beginning with 'antyajātiśvapākenetyādiḥ' and ending with 'tatra ācaredityantaḥ' is missing in manuscript cha.
3 'śavantatatsparśinaṃ śvānamiti' in kha; 'śavantatspṛṣṭinaṃ śvānamiti' in gha and ja.
4 The passage beginning with 'mūtroccāraṃ dvijaḥ kṛtvetyādiḥ' and ending with 'pūyante pāpino 'khilā ityantaḥ' is missing in manuscripts ja and jha.
Now begins the one hundred and seventy-first chapter.
Expiations.

171.s:
puṣkara uvāca
prāyaścittaṃ rahasyādi vakṣye śuddhikaraṃ para /
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena māsaṃ japyādināghahā //
171.d:
पुष्कर उवाच
प्रायश्चित्तं रहस्यादि वक्ष्ये शुद्धिकरं पर /
पौरुषेण तु सूक्तेन मासं जप्यादिनाघहा //
171.m: Puṣkara said: / I shall declare the supreme expiations—secret and otherwise—that effect purification. / One destroys sin by reciting the Pauruṣa hymn for a month or the like.

171.s:
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair japtvā triraghamarṣaṇaṃ /
vedajapyādvāyuyamād gāyatryā vratato 'dyahā(1) //
171.d:
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर् जप्त्वा त्रिरघमर्षणं /
वेदजप्याद्वायुयमाद् गायत्र्या व्रततो ऽद्यहा(1) //
171.m: One is freed from all mortal sins by reciting the Aghamarṣaṇa thrice, / [or] destroys sin today by reciting the Vedas, by breath-control, by the Gāyatrī, and by votive observance.

171.s:
muṇḍanaṃ sarvakṛcchreṣu snānaṃ homo hareryajiḥ /
utthitastu divā tiṣṭhedupaviṣṭas tathā niśi //
171.d:
मुण्डनं सर्वकृच्छ्रेषु स्नानं होमो हरेर्यजिः /
उत्थितस्तु दिवा तिष्ठेदुपविष्टस् तथा निशि //
171.m: Tonsure, bathing, fire oblation, and sacrifice to Hari [are prescribed] in all kṛcchras. / One should stand upright during the day and sit at night;

171.s:
etadvīrāsanaṃ proktaṃ kṛcchrakṛttena pāpahā /
aṣṭabhiḥ pratyahaṃ grāsair yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtaṃ //
171.d:
एतद्वीरासनं प्रोक्तं कृच्छ्रकृत्तेन पापहा /
अष्टभिः प्रत्यहं ग्रासैर् यतिचान्द्रायणं स्मृतं //
171.m: this is declared to be the heroic posture (vīrāsana); by this, the performer of the kṛcchra destroys sin. / Eating eight mouthfuls each day is known as the ascetic's cāndrāyaṇa.

171.s:
prātaś caturbhiḥ sāyañca śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtaṃ /
yathākathañcit piṇḍānām catvāriṃśacchatadvayaṃ //
171.d:
प्रातश् चतुर्भिः सायञ्च शिशुचान्द्रायणं स्मृतं /
यथाकथञ्चित् पिण्डानाम् चत्वारिंशच्छतद्वयं //
171.m: Four mouthfuls in the morning and [four] in the evening is known as the child's cāndrāyaṇa. / Consuming in any manner two hundred and forty mouthfuls

171.s:
māsena bhakṣayedetat suracāndrāyaṇaṃ caret /
tryahamuṣṇaṃ pivedāpastyahamuṣṇaṃ payaḥ pivet //
171.d:
मासेन भक्षयेदेतत् सुरचान्द्रायणं चरेत् /
त्र्यहमुष्णं पिवेदापस्त्यहमुष्णं पयः पिवेत् //
171.m: over a month—one should perform this as the gods' cāndrāyaṇa. / For three days one should drink warm water; for three days one should drink warm milk;

171.s:
tryāhamuṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā vāyubhakṣo bhavet tryahaṃ /
taptakṛcchramidaṃ proktaṃ śītaiḥ śītaṃ prakīrtitaṃ //
171.d:
त्र्याहमुष्णं घृतं पीत्वा वायुभक्षो भवेत् त्र्यहं /
तप्तकृच्छ्रमिदं प्रोक्तं शीतैः शीतं प्रकीर्तितं //
171.m: having drunk warm clarified butter for three days, one should subsist on air for three days. / This is declared as the taptakṛcchra; with cold [liquids] it is proclaimed as the śītakṛcchra.

171.s:
kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ payasā divasānekaviṃśatiṃ /
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakaṃ //
:n
1 japato 'vadhaheti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
:p 180
171.d:
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रं पयसा दिवसानेकविंशतिं /
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकं //
:न्
1 जपतो ऽवधहेति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
:प् 180
171.m:
The kṛcchrātikṛcchra is performed with milk for twenty-one days. / Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, clarified butter, and kuśa grass water,
:n
1 'japato 'vadhaheti' in kha, gha, and ja.

171.s:
ekarātropavāsaś cakṛcchraṃ śāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ /
etacca pratyābhyastaṃ mahāśāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ //
171.d:
एकरात्रोपवासश् चकृच्छ्रं शान्तपनं स्मृतं /
एतच्च प्रत्याभ्यस्तं महाशान्तपनं स्मृतं //
171.m: and fasting for one night, is known as the śāntapana kṛcchra. / And this, repeated day by day, is known as the mahāśāntapana.
Each of these repeated for three days is known as the atiśāntapana. / Complete abstinence from food for twelve days is the kṛcchra named parāka.

171.s:
ekabhaktaṃ tryahābhyastaṃ kramānnaktamayācitaṃ /
prājāpatyamupoṣyānte pādaḥ syāt kṛcchrapādakaḥ //
171.d:
एकभक्तं त्र्यहाभ्यस्तं क्रमान्नक्तमयाचितं /
प्राजापत्यमुपोष्यान्ते पादः स्यात् कृच्छ्रपादकः //
171.m: Eating a single meal [in the day] for three days, then similarly at night, then unasked-for food, / and fasting at the end, is the prājāpatya; one quarter [of it] is the kṛcchrapāda.

171.s:
phalair māsaṃ phalaṃ kṛcchraṃ bilvaiḥ śrīkcchra īritaḥ /
padmākṣaiḥ syādāmalakaiḥ puṣpakṛcchraṃ tu puṣpakaiḥ //
171.d:
फलैर् मासं फलं कृच्छ्रं बिल्वैः श्रीक्च्छ्र ईरितः /
पद्माक्षैः स्यादामलकैः पुष्पकृच्छ्रं तु पुष्पकैः //
171.m: Living on fruits for a month is the phalakṛcchra; on bilva fruits it is declared to be the śrīkṛcchra; / on lotus seeds or āmalakas, [or] on flowers, it is the puṣpakṛcchra;

171.s:
patrakṛcchrantathā patraistoyakṛcchraṃ jalena tu /
mūlakṛcchrantathā mūlair dṛdhna kṣīreṇa takrataḥ //
171.d:
पत्रकृच्छ्रन्तथा पत्रैस्तोयकृच्छ्रं जलेन तु /
मूलकृच्छ्रन्तथा मूलैर् दृध्न क्षीरेण तक्रतः //
171.m: likewise, with leaves it is the patrakṛcchra, and with water it is the toyakṛcchra; / likewise, with roots it is the mūlakṛcchra; [and similarly] with curd, milk, or buttermilk.

171.s:
māsaṃ vāyavyakṛcchraṃ syātpāṇipūrānnabhojanāt /
tilair dvādaśarātreṇa kṛcchramāgneyamārtinut //
171.d:
मासं वायव्यकृच्छ्रं स्यात्पाणिपूरान्नभोजनात् /
तिलैर् द्वादशरात्रेण कृच्छ्रमाग्नेयमार्तिनुत् //
171.m: For a month, eating only a handful of food is the vāyavyakṛcchra. / Living on sesame seeds for twelve nights is the āgneyakṛcchra, which dispels distress.

171.s:
pākṣaṃ prasṛtyā lājānāṃ brahmakūrcaṃ tathā bhavet /
upoṣitaś caturdṛśyāṃ pañcadaśyāmanantaraṃ //
171.d:
पाक्षं प्रसृत्या लाजानां ब्रह्मकूर्चं तथा भवेत् /
उपोषितश् चतुर्दृश्यां पञ्चदश्यामनन्तरं //
171.m: Consuming a handful of puffed grain for a fortnight is the brahmakūrca. / Having fasted on the fourteenth lunar day, then on the fifteenth

171.s:
pañcagavyaṃ samaśnīyāddhaviṣyāśītyanantaraṃ /
māsena dvir naraḥ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
171.d:
पञ्चगव्यं समश्नीयाद्धविष्याशीत्यनन्तरं /
मासेन द्विर् नरः कृत्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
171.m: one should consume the five products of the cow, and thereafter eat sacrificial food. / Having performed this twice in a month, a person is freed from all sins.

171.s:
śrīkāmaḥ puṣṭikāmaś ca svargakāmo 'ghanaṣṭaye /
devatārādhanaparaḥ kṛcchrakārī sa sarvabhāk //
:e ity āgneye mahāpureṇe rahasyādiprāyaśvittaṃ nāma
ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:p 181
:ś atha dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
sarvapāpaprāyaścittāni
171.d:
श्रीकामः पुष्टिकामश् च स्वर्गकामो ऽघनष्टये /
देवताराधनपरः कृच्छ्रकारी स सर्वभाक् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुरेणे रहस्यादिप्रायश्वित्तं नाम
एकसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:प् 181
:श् अथ द्विसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
सर्वपापप्रायश्चित्तानि
171.m:
One who desires prosperity, nourishment, or heaven, or seeks the destruction of sins, / devoted to the worship of the deities and performing kṛcchras, obtains everything.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-first chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, named 'Expiations: Secret and Otherwise'.
:p 181
Now begins the one hundred and seventy-second chapter.
Expiations for All Sins.

172.s:
puṣkara uvāca
paradāraparadravyajīvahiṃsādike yadā /
pravartate nṛṇāṃ cittaṃ prāyaścittaṃ stutistadā //
172.d:
पुष्कर उवाच
परदारपरद्रव्यजीवहिंसादिके यदा /
प्रवर्तते नृणां चित्तं प्रायश्चित्तं स्तुतिस्तदा //
172.m: Puṣkara said: / When people's minds turn toward adultery, taking others' wealth, harming living beings, and the like, / then praise [of God] is the expiation:

172.s:
viṣṇave viṣṇave nityaṃ viṣṇave viṣṇave(1) namaḥ /
namāmi viṣṇuṃ cittasthamahaṅkāragatiṃ hariṃ //
172.d:
विष्णवे विष्णवे नित्यं विष्णवे विष्णवे(1) नमः /
नमामि विष्णुं चित्तस्थमहङ्कारगतिं हरिं //
172.m: 'To Viṣṇu, to Viṣṇu, ever to Viṣṇu, to Viṣṇu, salutations! / I bow to Viṣṇu, who dwells in the heart, the destination of ego, Hari;

172.s:
cittasthamīśamavyaktamanantamaparājitaṃ /
viṣṇumīḍyamaśeṣeṇa anādinidhanaṃ vibhuṃ //
172.d:
चित्तस्थमीशमव्यक्तमनन्तमपराजितं /
विष्णुमीड्यमशेषेण अनादिनिधनं विभुं //
172.m: the Lord residing in the heart, unmanifest, infinite, unconquered, / Viṣṇu, praised by all without remainder, without beginning or end, the all-pervading.

172.s:
viṣṇuścittagato yanme viṣṇurbuddhigataś ca yat /
yaccāhaṅkārago viṣṇuryadviṣṇurmayi saṃsthitaḥ //
172.d:
विष्णुश्चित्तगतो यन्मे विष्णुर्बुद्धिगतश् च यत् /
यच्चाहङ्कारगो विष्णुर्यद्विष्णुर्मयि संस्थितः //
172.m: Because Viṣṇu is present in my heart, because Viṣṇu is present in my intellect, / because Viṣṇu is within my ego, and because Viṣṇu dwells within me,

172.s:
karoti karmabhūto 'sau sthavarasya carasya ca /
tat pāpannāśamāyātu tasminneva hi cintite //
172.d:
करोति कर्मभूतो ऽसौ स्थवरस्य चरस्य च /
तत् पापन्नाशमायातु तस्मिन्नेव हि चिन्तिते //
172.m: and manifests as the action of the immovable and the moving, / may that sin come to destruction when he is merely meditated upon!

172.s:
dhyāto harati yat pāpaṃ svapne dṛṣṭastu bhāvanāt /
tamupendramahaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇatārtiharaṃ hariṃ //
172.d:
ध्यातो हरति यत् पापं स्वप्ने दृष्टस्तु भावनात् /
तमुपेन्द्रमहं विष्णुं प्रणतार्तिहरं हरिं //
172.m: Meditation upon whom takes away sin, and who is seen in a dream through deep contemplation— / to that Upendra, Viṣṇu, the remover of the distress of those who bow, to Hari;

172.s:
jagatyasminnirādhāre majjamāne tamasyadhaḥ /
hastāvalambanaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇamāmi parāt paraṃ //
172.d:
जगत्यस्मिन्निराधारे मज्जमाने तमस्यधः /
हस्तावलम्बनं विष्णुं प्रणमामि परात् परं //
172.m: in this unsupported world sinking down into darkness, / to Viṣṇu, the supporting hand, higher than the highest, I bow.

172.s:
sarveśvareśvara vibho paramātmannadhokṣaja /
hṛṣīkeśa hṛṣīkeśa hṛṣīkeśa namo 'stu te //
172.d:
सर्वेश्वरेश्वर विभो परमात्मन्नधोक्षज /
हृषीकेश हृषीकेश हृषीकेश नमो ऽस्तु ते //
172.m: O Sovereign of all lords, O omnipresent one, O Supreme Self, O Adhokṣaja, / O Hṛṣīkeśa, O Hṛṣīkeśa, O Hṛṣīkeśa, salutations to you!

172.s:
nṛsiṃhānanta govinda bhūtabhavana keśava /
:n
1 viṣṇave viṣṇave iti ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 182
duruktaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ dhyātaṃ śamayāghannamo 'stu te //
172.d:
नृसिंहानन्त गोविन्द भूतभवन केशव /
:न्
1 विष्णवे विष्णवे इति ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 182
दुरुक्तं दुष्कृतं ध्यातं शमयाघन्नमो ऽस्तु ते //
172.m:
O Nṛsiṃha, O Infinite One, O Govinda, O source of all beings, O Keśava!
:n
1 'viṣṇave viṣṇave iti' in ja and ña.
pacify what was wrongly spoken, wrongly done, or thought, O destroyer of sin! Salutations to you!

172.s:
yanmayā cintitaṃ duṣṭaṃ svacittavaśavartinā /
akāryamahadatyugrantacchamannaya keśava //
172.d:
यन्मया चिन्तितं दुष्टं स्वचित्तवशवर्तिना /
अकार्यमहदत्युग्रन्तच्छमन्नय केशव //
172.m: Whatever evil was conceived by me, acting under the control of my own mind— / that terrible, great deed that should not be done—bring it to peace, O Keśava!

172.s:
brahmaṇyadeva govinda paramārthaparāyaṇa /
jagannātha jagaddhātaḥ pāpaṃ praśamayācyuta //
172.d:
ब्रह्मण्यदेव गोविन्द परमार्थपरायण /
जगन्नाथ जगद्धातः पापं प्रशमयाच्युत //
172.m: O Deity of the brāhmaṇas, O Govinda, devoted to the ultimate truth, / O Lord of the world, O sustainer of the world, pacify my sin, O Acyuta!

172.s:
yathāparāhṇe sāyāhṇe madhyāhṇe ca tathā niśi /
kāyena manasā vācā kṛtaṃ pāpamajānatā //
172.d:
यथापराह्णे सायाह्णे मध्याह्णे च तथा निशि /
कायेन मनसा वाचा कृतं पापमजानता //
172.m: Whatever sin has been committed unknowingly by body, mind, or speech / in the afternoon, in the evening, at midday, or at night,

172.s:
jānatā ca hṛṣīkeśa puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava /
nāmatrayoccāraṇataḥ svapne yātu mama kṣayaṃ //
172.d:
जानता च हृषीकेश पुण्डरीकाक्ष माधव /
नामत्रयोच्चारणतः स्वप्ने यातु मम क्षयं //
172.m: or knowingly, O Hṛṣīkeśa, O lotus-eyed one, O Mādhava— / by the utterance of these three names, even in a dream, may it go to its destruction!

172.s:
śārīraṃ me hṛṣīkeśa puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava /
pāpaṃ praśamayādya tvaṃ(1) bākkṛtaṃ mama mādhava //
172.d:
शारीरं मे हृषीकेश पुण्डरीकाक्ष माधव /
पापं प्रशमयाद्य त्वं(1) बाक्कृतं मम माधव //
172.m: O Hṛṣīkeśa, O lotus-eyed one, O Mādhava, / pacify today my bodily sin, and my sin committed by speech, O Mādhava!

172.s:
yadbhuñjanyatsvapaṃstiṣṭhan gacchan jāgrad yadāsthitaḥ /
kṛtavān pāpamadyāhaṃ kāyena manasā girā //
172.d:
यद्भुञ्जन्यत्स्वपंस्तिष्ठन् गच्छन् जाग्रद् यदास्थितः /
कृतवान् पापमद्याहं कायेन मनसा गिरा //
172.m: Whatever sin I have committed today through body, mind, or speech, / while eating, sleeping, standing, walking, awake, or sitting,

172.s:
yat svalpamapi yat sthūlaṃ kuyoninarakābahaṃ /
tadyātu praśamaṃ sarvaṃ vāsudevānukīrtanāt //
172.d:
यत् स्वल्पमपि यत् स्थूलं कुयोनिनरकाबहं /
तद्यातु प्रशमं सर्वं वासुदेवानुकीर्तनात् //
172.m: whether very minor or gross, leading to evil wombs or to hell— / may all that go to pacification through the recitation of Vāsudeva's names!

172.s:
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramañca yat /
tasmin(2) prakīrtite viṣṇau yat pāpaṃ tat praṇaśyatu //
172.d:
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमञ्च यत् /
तस्मिन्(2) प्रकीर्तिते विष्णौ यत् पापं तत् प्रणश्यतु //
172.m: The Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, that which is supremely pure— / when that Viṣṇu is proclaimed, may whatever sin there is perish!

172.s:
yat prāpya na nivartante gandhasparśadivarjitaṃ /
sūrayastat padaṃ viṣṇostat sarvaṃ śamayatvaghaṃ(3) //
172.d:
यत् प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते गन्धस्पर्शदिवर्जितं /
सूरयस्तत् पदं विष्णोस्तत् सर्वं शमयत्वघं(3) //
172.m: Having attained which the wise never return, devoid of smell, touch, and the rest— / may that state of Viṣṇu pacify all sin!'

172.s:
pāpapraṇāśanaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi(4) /
:n
1 praśamātyarthamiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
2 asminniti gha..
3 sarvaṃ gamayatvaghamiti jha..
4 yaḥ paṭecchraddhayā nara iti ja.. , jha.. ca / yaḥ
paṭhecchṛṇuyānnara iti ña..
:p 183
śārīrair mānasair vāgjaiḥ kṛtaiḥ papaiḥ pramucyate //
172.d:
पापप्रणाशनं स्तोत्रं यः पठेच्छृणुयादपि(4) /
:न्
1 प्रशमात्यर्थमिति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
2 अस्मिन्निति घ..
3 सर्वं गमयत्वघमिति झ..
4 यः पटेच्छ्रद्धया नर इति ज.. , झ.. च / यः
पठेच्छृणुयान्नर इति ञ..
:प् 183
शारीरैर् मानसैर् वाग्जैः कृतैः पपैः प्रमुच्यते //
172.m:
Whoever recites or even listens to this hymn that destroys sin
:n
1 'praśamātyarthamiti' in kha, gha, and ja.
2 'asminniti' in gha.
[Variant reading:] 3 ‘sarvaṃ gamayatvagham’ in manuscript jha.
[Variant reading:] 4 ‘yaḥ paṭecchraddhayā naraḥ’ in manuscripts ja and jha; ‘yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānnaraḥ’ in manuscript ña.
he is liberated from sins committed—bodily, mental, or produced by speech.

172.s:
sarvapāpagrahādibhyo yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padaṃ /
tasmāt pāpe kṛte japyaṃ stotraṃ sarvāghamardanaṃ //
172.d:
सर्वपापग्रहादिभ्यो याति विष्णोः परं पदं /
तस्मात् पापे कृते जप्यं स्तोत्रं सर्वाघमर्दनं //
172.m: From all sins, planetary afflictions, and the like, he goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu. / Therefore, when a sin is committed, this praise, which destroys all sin, is to be recited.

172.s:
prāyaścittamaghaughānāṃ stotraṃ vratakṛte varaṃ /
prāyaścittaiḥ stotrajapair vratair naśyati pātakaṃ //
172.d:
प्रायश्चित्तमघौघानां स्तोत्रं व्रतकृते वरं /
प्रायश्चित्तैः स्तोत्रजपैर् व्रतैर् नश्यति पातकं //
172.m: For hosts of sins, expiation by means of praise is best for one performing votive observances. / Through expiations, recitations of praise, and votive observances, a grave sin is destroyed.

172.s:
tataḥ kāryāṇi(1) saṃsiddhyai tāni vai bhuktimuktaye //22//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe sarvapāpaprāyaścitte pāpanāśanastotraṃ
nāma dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāyaścittaṃ
172.d:
ततः कार्याणि(1) संसिद्ध्यै तानि वै भुक्तिमुक्तये //22//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे सर्वपापप्रायश्चित्ते पापनाशनस्तोत्रं
नाम द्विसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ त्रिसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रायश्चित्तं
172.m:
Then those rites should be performed for complete success, indeed for worldly enjoyment and liberation. //22
Thus ends the hundred and seventy-second chapter, titled ‘The Praise That Destroys Sins’, in the context of expiation for all sins, in the Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Agni.
Now begins the hundred and seventy-third chapter.
[Topic:] Expiation.

173.s:
agnir uvāca
prāyaścittaṃ brahṇoktaṃ vakṣye pāpopaśāntidaṃ /
syāt prāṇaviyogaphalo vyāpāro hananaṃ smṛtaṃ //
173.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
प्रायश्चित्तं ब्रह्णोक्तं वक्ष्ये पापोपशान्तिदं /
स्यात् प्राणवियोगफलो व्यापारो हननं स्मृतं //
173.m: Agni said: / I shall state the expiation declared by Brahmā, which brings about the cessation of sins. / The activity whose consequence is the separation of life-breaths is remembered as killing.

173.s:
rāgād dveṣāt pramādācca svataḥ parata eva vā /
brāhmaṇaṃ ghātayedyastu sa bhavedbrahmaghātakaḥ //
173.d:
रागाद् द्वेषात् प्रमादाच्च स्वतः परत एव वा /
ब्राह्मणं घातयेद्यस्तु स भवेद्ब्रह्मघातकः //
173.m: Whether from passion, hatred, or negligence, directly by oneself or through another, / he who causes a brāhmaṇa to be slain is a slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

173.s:
bahūnāmekakāryāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śastradhāriṇāṃ /
yadyeko ghātakastatra sarve te ghātakāḥ smṛtāḥ //
173.d:
बहूनामेककार्याणां सर्वेषां शस्त्रधारिणां /
यद्येको घातकस्तत्र सर्वे ते घातकाः स्मृताः //
173.m: When many people have a single objective, all carrying weapons, / if one among them is the killer, all of them are remembered as killers.

173.s:
ākrośitastāḍito vā dhanaivvā paripīḍitaḥ /
:n
1 tataḥ karmāṇīti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca
:p 184
yamuddiśya tyajet prāṇāṃstamāhurbrahmaghātakaṃ //
173.d:
आक्रोशितस्ताडितो वा धनैव्वा परिपीडितः /
:न्
1 ततः कर्माणीति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , छ.. च
:प् 184
यमुद्दिश्य त्यजेत् प्राणांस्तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकं //
173.m:
Abused, beaten, or afflicted in terms of wealth,
[Footnote]
[Footnote:] 1 ‘tataḥ karmāṇi’ in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, and cha.
he on account of whom one gives up life-breaths is called the slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

173.s:
auṣadhādyupakāre tu na pāpaṃ syāt kṛte mṛte /
putraṃ śiṣyantathā bhāryāṃ śāsate na mṛte hy aghaṃ //
173.d:
औषधाद्युपकारे तु न पापं स्यात् कृते मृते /
पुत्रं शिष्यन्तथा भार्यां शासते न मृते ह्य् अघं //
173.m: When assistance through medicine and the like has been rendered and death occurs, there is no sin. / In the case of disciplining a son, a pupil, or a wife, if death occurs, there is indeed no guilt.

173.s:
deśaṃ kālañca yaḥ śaktiṃ pāpañcāvekṣya yatnataḥ /
prāyaścittaṃ prakalpyaṃ syādyatra coktā ba niṣkṛtiḥ(1) //
173.d:
देशं कालञ्च यः शक्तिं पापञ्चावेक्ष्य यत्नतः /
प्रायश्चित्तं प्रकल्प्यं स्याद्यत्र चोक्ता ब निष्कृतिः(1) //
173.m: Having carefully examined the place, time, capability, and the sin, / an expiation should be assigned where no specific remedy has been stated.

173.s:
gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā sadyaḥ prāṇān parityajet /
prāsyedātmānamagnau vā mucyate brahmahatyayā //
173.d:
गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे वा सद्यः प्राणान् परित्यजेत् /
प्रास्येदात्मानमग्नौ वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया //
173.m: For the sake of cows or for the sake of a brāhmaṇa, one should instantly surrender one's life, / or cast oneself into fire: one is freed from the killing of a brāhmaṇa.

173.s:
śiraḥkapālī dhvajavān bhaikṣāśī karma vedayan /
brahmahā dvādaśābdāni mitabhuk śuddhimāpnuyāt //
173.d:
शिरःकपाली ध्वजवान् भैक्षाशी कर्म वेदयन् /
ब्रह्महा द्वादशाब्दानि मितभुक् शुद्धिमाप्नुयात् //
173.m: Carrying a human skull, bearing a staff, eating begged food, proclaiming his deed, / eating moderately, a brāhmaṇa-slayer attains purity after twelve years.

173.s:
ṣaḍbhirvarṣaiḥ śuddhacārī brahmahā pūyate naraḥ /
vihitaṃ yadakāmā māṃ kāmāttu dviguṇaṃ smṛtaṃ //
173.d:
षड्भिर्वर्षैः शुद्धचारी ब्रह्महा पूयते नरः /
विहितं यदकामा मां कामात्तु द्विगुणं स्मृतं //
173.m: Living purely for six years, a man who has slain a brāhmaṇa is purified. / That which is prescribed is for unintentional [killing]; but for intentional it is declared to be double.

173.s:
prāyaścittaṃ pravṛttasya badhe syāttu(2) trivārṣikaṃ /
brahmaghni kṣatre dviguṇaṃ viṭcchūdre dviguṇaṃ tridhā //
173.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं प्रवृत्तस्य बधे स्यात्तु(2) त्रिवार्षिकं /
ब्रह्मघ्नि क्षत्रे द्विगुणं विट्च्छूद्रे द्विगुणं त्रिधा //
173.m: The expiation for killing one who has undertaken [a sacrifice] is three years. / If a kṣatriya kills a brāhmaṇa, [the penance] is doubled; for a vaiśya or a śūdra, it is doubled threefold.

173.s:
anyatra vipre sakalaṃ pādonaṃ kṣatriye mataṃ /
vaiśye 'rdhapādaṃ kṣatre syādvṛddhastrībālarogiṣu //
173.d:
अन्यत्र विप्रे सकलं पादोनं क्षत्रिये मतं /
वैश्ये ऽर्धपादं क्षत्रे स्याद्वृद्धस्त्रीबालरोगिषु //
173.m: Elsewhere, in the case of a vipra, it is full; for a kṣatriya, it is considered one quarter less. / For a vaiśya, it is half a quarter; in the case of a kṣatriya [slaying] the aged, women, children, and the sick,

173.s:
turīyo brahmahatyāyāḥ kṣatriyasya badhe smṛtaṃ /
vaiśye 'ṣṭamāṃśo vṛttasthe śūdre jñeyastu ṣoḍaśaḥ //
173.d:
तुरीयो ब्रह्महत्यायाः क्षत्रियस्य बधे स्मृतं /
वैश्ये ऽष्टमांशो वृत्तस्थे शूद्रे ज्ञेयस्तु षोडशः //
173.m: one fourth of [the penance for] killing a brāhmaṇa is remembered for slaying a kṣatriya; / for [slaying] an upright vaiśya, an eighth part; but for a śūdra, a sixteenth is to be known.

173.s:
apraduṣṭāṃ striyaṃ hatvā śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret /
pañcagavyaṃ pivedgoghno māsamāsīta saṃyataḥ //
173.d:
अप्रदुष्टां स्त्रियं हत्वा शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत् /
पञ्चगव्यं पिवेद्गोघ्नो मासमासीत संयतः //
173.m: Having slain an uncorrupted woman, one should perform the observance for slaying a śūdra. / A cow-killer should drink pañcagavya and dwell restrained for a month.

173.s:
goṣṭhe śayo go 'nugāmī gopradānena śuddhyati /
kṛcchrañcaivātikṛcchraṃ vā pādahrāso nṛpādiṣu //
173.d:
गोष्ठे शयो गो ऽनुगामी गोप्रदानेन शुद्ध्यति /
कृच्छ्रञ्चैवातिकृच्छ्रं वा पादह्रासो नृपादिषु //
173.m: Sleeping in a cowshed, following cows, he is purified by the gift of a cow. / [He performs] a kṛcchra or an atikṛcchra penance; there is a reduction of a quarter in the case of kings and others.

173.s:
ativṛddhāmatikṛśāmatibālāñca rogiṇīṃ /
:n
1 na saṃskṛtiriti cha..
2 badhe 'sya tu iti cha..
:p 185
hatvā pūrvavidhānena caredardhavrataṃ dvijaḥ //
173.d:
अतिवृद्धामतिकृशामतिबालाञ्च रोगिणीं /
:न्
1 न संस्कृतिरिति छ..
2 बधे ऽस्य तु इति छ..
:प् 185
हत्वा पूर्वविधानेन चरेदर्धव्रतं द्विजः //
173.m:
Having slain an extremely old, extremely emaciated, extremely young, or diseased [cow],
[Footnote]
[Footnote:] 1 ‘na saṃskṛtiḥ’ in manuscript cha.
[Footnote:] 2 ‘badhe 'sya tu’ in manuscript cha.
a twice-born should perform half the observance according to the earlier rule.

173.s:
brāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā dadyāddhematiladikaṃ /
muṣṭicapeṭakīlena tathā śṛṅgādimoṭane //
173.d:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेच्छक्त्या दद्याद्धेमतिलदिकं /
मुष्टिचपेटकीलेन तथा शृङ्गादिमोटने //
173.m: He should feed brāhmaṇas according to his ability and give gold, sesame seeds, and the like. / By a fist, a slap, or a peg, as well as breaking a horn or the like,

173.s:
laguḍādiprahāreṇa gobadhaṃ tatra nirdiśet /
damena dāmane caiva śakaṭādau ca yojane //
173.d:
लगुडादिप्रहारेण गोबधं तत्र निर्दिशेत् /
दमेन दामने चैव शकटादौ च योजने //
173.m: [or] by a blow with a staff or the like, cow-killing should be declared in that case; / or by subjugation, in taming, and in yoking to a cart or the like,

173.s:
stambhaśṛṅkhalapāśair vā mṛte pādonamācaret /
kāṣṭhe śāntapanaṃ kuryāt prājāpatyantu loṣṭhake //
173.d:
स्तम्भशृङ्खलपाशैर् वा मृते पादोनमाचरेत् /
काष्ठे शान्तपनं कुर्यात् प्राजापत्यन्तु लोष्ठके //
173.m: or if it dies by a post, an iron chain, or ropes, one should observe three-fourths [of the penance]. / For [striking with] wood, one should perform a śāntapana; for a clod of earth, a prājāpatya.

173.s:
taptakṛcchrantu pāṣāṇe śastre cāpyatikṛcchrakaṃ /
mārjāragodhānakulamaṇḍūkaśvapatatriṇaḥ //
173.d:
तप्तकृच्छ्रन्तु पाषाणे शस्त्रे चाप्यतिकृच्छ्रकं /
मार्जारगोधानकुलमण्डूकश्वपतत्रिणः //
173.m: For a stone, a taptakṛcchra; and for a weapon, an atikṛcchra. / Having killed a cat, an iguana, a mongoose, a frog, a dog, or a bird,

173.s:
hatvā tryahaṃ pivet kṣīraṃ kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret /
vrataṃ rahasye rahasi prakāśe 'pi prakāśakaṃ //
173.d:
हत्वा त्र्यहं पिवेत् क्षीरं कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं चरेत् /
व्रतं रहस्ये रहसि प्रकाशे ऽपि प्रकाशकं //
173.m: one should drink milk for three days, or perform a kṛcchra or a cāndrāyaṇa penance. / The observance for a secret [sin] is secret, and for a public [sin] it is public.

173.s:
prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kāryaṃ sarvapāpāpanuttaye /
pānakaṃ drākṣamadhukaṃ khārjarantālamaikṣavaṃ //
173.d:
प्राणायामशतं कार्यं सर्वपापापनुत्तये /
पानकं द्राक्षमधुकं खार्जरन्तालमैक्षवं //
173.m: A hundred breath-controls should be performed for the removal of all sins. / Sweet liquor made from grapes, madhūka, dates, palmyra, sugarcane,

173.s:
madhvīkaṃ ṭaṅkamādhvīkaṃ maireyaṃ(?) nārikelajaṃ /
na madyānyapi madyāni paiṣṭī mukhyā surā smṛtā //
173.d:
मध्वीकं टङ्कमाध्वीकं मैरेयं(?) नारिकेलजं /
न मद्यान्यपि मद्यानि पैष्टी मुख्या सुरा स्मृता //
173.m: honey, wood-apple, madhvīka, maireya, or coconut-juice: / these are not non-intoxicants, but intoxicants; liquor made from grain is remembered as the chief liquor.

173.s:
traivarṇasya niṣiddhāni pītvā taptvāpyapaḥ śuciḥ /
kaṇān vā bhakṣayedabdaṃ piṇyākaṃ vā sakṛnniśi //
173.d:
त्रैवर्णस्य निषिद्धानि पीत्वा तप्त्वाप्यपः शुचिः /
कणान् वा भक्षयेदब्दं पिण्याकं वा सकृन्निशि //
173.m: They are forbidden for the three classes; having drunk them, one becomes pure by burning [with hot water]. / Or he should eat grain-particles for a year, or oil-cake once at night.

173.s:
surāpāṇāpanutyarthaṃ bālavāmā jaṭī dhvajī /
ajñānāt prāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca //
173.d:
सुरापाणापनुत्यर्थं बालवामा जटी ध्वजी /
अज्ञानात् प्राश्य विण्मूत्रं सुरासंस्पृष्टमेव च //
173.m: To remove the sin of drinking liquor, wearing hair-cloth, matted hair, and carrying a staff, / or having consumed feces or urine out of ignorance, or food touched by liquor,

173.s:
punaḥ saṃskāramarhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ /
madyamāṇḍasthitā āpaḥ pītvā saptadinaṃ vratī //
173.d:
पुनः संस्कारमर्हन्ति त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः /
मद्यमाण्डस्थिता आपः पीत्वा सप्तदिनं व्रती //
173.m: the three twice-born classes are fit for a fresh sacramental rite. / Having drunk water standing in an intoxicating liquor vessel, one should observe a vow for seven days.

173.s:
cāṇḍālasya tu pānīyaṃ pītvā syāt ṣaḍdinaṃ vratī /
caṇḍālakūpabhāṇḍeṣu pītvā śāntapanaṃ caret //
:p 186
173.d:
चाण्डालस्य तु पानीयं पीत्वा स्यात् षड्दिनं व्रती /
चण्डालकूपभाण्डेषु पीत्वा शान्तपनं चरेत् //
:प् 186
173.m:
Having drunk water belonging to an outcaste, one should observe a vow for six days. / Having drunk from wells or vessels of an outcaste, one should perform a śāntapana.
[Page 186]

173.s:
pañcagavyaṃ trirānte pītvā cāntyajalaṃ dvijaḥ /
matsyakaṇṭakaśambūkaśaṅkhaśuktikapardakān //
173.d:
पञ्चगव्यं त्रिरान्ते पीत्वा चान्त्यजलं द्विजः /
मत्स्यकण्टकशम्बूकशङ्खशुक्तिकपर्दकान् //
173.m: Having drunk water of the lowest outcaste, a twice-born, after drinking pañcagavya for three nights, / [and having drunk water with] fish-bones, snails, conches, mother-of-pearl, or cowrie-shells,

173.s:
pītvā navodakaṃ caiva pañcagavyena śuddhyati /
śavakūpodakaṃ pītvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati //
173.d:
पीत्वा नवोदकं चैव पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति /
शवकूपोदकं पीत्वा त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति //
173.m: and also having drunk newly collected rainwater, is purified by pañcagavya. / Having drunk water from a well containing a corpse, he is purified in three nights.

173.s:
antyāvasāyināmannaṃ bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret /
āpatkāle śūdragṛhe manastāpena śuddhyati //
173.d:
अन्त्यावसायिनामन्नं भुक्त्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत् /
आपत्काले शूद्रगृहे मनस्तापेन शुद्ध्यति //
173.m: Having eaten food of outcastes living at the edge of the settlement, one should perform a cāndrāyaṇa. / In a time of distress, in the house of a śūdra, one is purified by remorse.

173.s:
śūdrabhājanabhuk vipraḥ pañcagavyādupoṣitaḥ /
kandupakvaṃ snehapakvaṃ snehaṃ ca dadhiśaktavaḥ //
173.d:
शूद्रभाजनभुक् विप्रः पञ्चगव्यादुपोषितः /
कन्दुपक्वं स्नेहपक्वं स्नेहं च दधिशक्तवः //
173.m: A vipra who eats from a śūdra's vessel, having fasted, [is purified] by pañcagavya. / Food cooked in an iron pan, food cooked in oil, clarified butter, curd, and roasted barley meal:

173.s:
śūdrādanindyānyetāni guḍakṣīrarasādikaṃ /
asnātabhuk copavāsī dinānte tu japācchuciḥ //
173.d:
शूद्रादनिन्द्यान्येतानि गुडक्षीररसादिकं /
अस्नातभुक् चोपवासी दिनान्ते तु जपाच्छुचिः //
173.m: these are irreproachable from a śūdra, as well as jaggery, milk, juices, and the like. / One who eats without bathing should fast, and at the end of the day he is purified by recitation.

173.s:
mūtroccāryaśucirbhuktvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati /
keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca pādaspṛṣṭañca kāmataḥ //
173.d:
मूत्रोच्चार्यशुचिर्भुक्त्वा त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति /
केशकीटावपन्नं च पादस्पृष्टञ्च कामतः //
173.m: Having eaten while impure with urine or feces, one is purified in three nights. / Food fallen into with hair or insects, intentionally touched by a foot,

173.s:
bhrūṇaghnāvekṣittaṃ caiva saspṛṣṭaṃ vāpyudakyayā /
kākādyair avalīḍhaṃ ca śunāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca //
173.d:
भ्रूणघ्नावेक्षित्तं चैव सस्पृष्टं वाप्युदक्यया /
काकाद्यैर् अवलीढं च शुनासंस्पृष्टमेव च //
173.m: viewed by a slayer of an embryo, touched by a menstruating woman, / licked by crows and the like, or touched by a dog,

173.s:
gavādyair annamāghrātaṃ bhuktvā tryahamupāvaset /
retoviṇmūtrabhakṣī tu prājāpatyaṃ samācaret //
173.d:
गवाद्यैर् अन्नमाघ्रातं भुक्त्वा त्र्यहमुपावसेत् /
रेतोविण्मूत्रभक्षी तु प्राजापत्यं समाचरेत् //
173.m: having eaten food smelled by cows and the like, one should fast for three days. / One who consumes semen, feces, or urine, however, should perform a prājāpatya.

173.s:
cāndrāyaṇa navaśrāddhe parāko māsike mataḥ /
pakṣatraye 'tikṛcchraṃ syāt ṣaṇmāse kṛcchrameva ca //
173.d:
चान्द्रायण नवश्राद्धे पराको मासिके मतः /
पक्षत्रये ऽतिकृच्छ्रं स्यात् षण्मासे कृच्छ्रमेव च //
173.m: A cāndrāyaṇa [is prescribed for eating] in a newly performed ancestral rite; a parāka is considered [prescribed] in a monthly rite. / In one of three fortnights, it should be an atikṛcchra; in one of six months, a kṛcchra.

173.s:
ābdike pādakṛcchraṃ syādekāhaḥ punarāvdike /
pūrvedyurvārṣikaṃ śrāddhaṃ paredyuḥ punarāvdikaṃ //
173.d:
आब्दिके पादकृच्छ्रं स्यादेकाहः पुनराव्दिके /
पूर्वेद्युर्वार्षिकं श्राद्धं परेद्युः पुनराव्दिकं //
173.m: In an annual rite, it should be a quarter-kṛcchra; a one-day fast in a second annual rite. / On the preceding day is the annual ancestral rite; on the following day is the second annual rite.

173.s:
niṣiddhabhakṣaṇe bhukte prāyaścittamupoṣaṇaṃ /
bhūstṛṇaṃ laśunaṃ bhuktvā(1) śiśukaṃ kṛcchramācaret(2) //
:n
1 laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ bhuktveti ṅa..
2 śiśukṛcchraṃ samācarediti kha..
:p 187
173.d:
निषिद्धभक्षणे भुक्ते प्रायश्चित्तमुपोषणं /
भूस्तृणं लशुनं भुक्त्वा(1) शिशुकं कृच्छ्रमाचरेत्(2) //
:न्
1 लशुनं गृञ्जनं भुक्त्वेति ङ..
2 शिशुकृच्छ्रं समाचरेदिति ख..
:प् 187
173.m:
When forbidden food is eaten, the expiation is fasting. / Having eaten bhūstṛṇa grass, garlic, or śiśuka, one should perform a kṛcchra.
[Footnote]
[Footnote:] 1 ‘laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ bhuktvā’ in manuscript ṅa.
[Footnote:] 2 ‘śiśukṛcchraṃ samācaret’ in manuscript kha.

173.s:
abhojyānāntu bhuktvānnaṃ strīśūdrocchiṣṭameva ca /
jagdhvā māṃsamabhakṣyañca saptarātraṃ payaḥ pivet //
173.d:
अभोज्यानान्तु भुक्त्वान्नं स्त्रीशूद्रोच्छिष्टमेव च /
जग्ध्वा मांसमभक्ष्यञ्च सप्तरात्रं पयः पिवेत् //
173.m: Having eaten the food of those whose food should not be eaten, or the remnants of women or śūdras, / and having eaten meat unfit to be eaten, one should drink milk for seven nights.

173.s:
madhu māṃsañca yo 'śnīyācchāvaṃ sūtakameva vā /
prājāpatyaṃ caret kṛcchraṃ brahmacārī yatirvratī //
173.d:
मधु मांसञ्च यो ऽश्नीयाच्छावं सूतकमेव वा /
प्राजापत्यं चरेत् कृच्छ्रं ब्रह्मचारी यतिर्व्रती //
173.m: A student of the Veda, an ascetic, or one observing a votive observance who consumes honey or meat, / or [food associated with] impurity from death or birth, should perform the prājāpatya kṛcchra.

173.s:
anyayena parasvāpaharaṇaṃ steyamucyate /
musalena hato rājñā svarṇasteyī viśuddhyati //
173.d:
अन्ययेन परस्वापहरणं स्तेयमुच्यते /
मुसलेन हतो राज्ञा स्वर्णस्तेयी विशुद्ध्यति //
173.m: Unlawful seizure of another's property is called theft. / A thief of gold is purified when struck dead by the king with a club.

173.s:
adhaḥśāyī jaṭādhārī parṇamūlaphalāśanaḥ /
ekakālaṃ samaśnāno dvādaśābde viśuddhyati //
173.d:
अधःशायी जटाधारी पर्णमूलफलाशनः /
एककालं समश्नानो द्वादशाब्दे विशुद्ध्यति //
173.m: Sleeping on the ground, wearing matted hair, subsisting on leaves, roots, and fruits, / eating only once a day, one is purified in twelve years.

173.s:
rukmasteyī surāpaś ca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ /
steyaṃ kṛtvā surāṃ pītvā kṛcchrañcābdaṃ carennaraḥ //
173.d:
रुक्मस्तेयी सुरापश् च ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः /
स्तेयं कृत्वा सुरां पीत्वा कृच्छ्रञ्चाब्दं चरेन्नरः //
173.m: A thief of gold, a drinker of liquor, a killer of a Brahmin, and one who violates a guru's bed— / a man who commits theft or drinks liquor should observe a kṛcchra for a year.

173.s:
maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca /
ayaskāṃsyopalānāñca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇānnabhuk //
173.d:
मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां ताम्रस्य रजतस्य च /
अयस्कांस्योपलानाञ्च द्वादशाहं कणान्नभुक् //
173.m: [For the theft] of gems, pearls, coral, copper, or silver, / or iron, bronze, and stone, [one should fast] for twelve days, eating broken grains of rice.

173.s:
manuṣyāṇāntu haraṇe strīṇāṃ kṣetragṛhasya ca /
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ śuddhiścāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtaṃ //
173.d:
मनुष्याणान्तु हरणे स्त्रीणां क्षेत्रगृहस्य च /
वापीकूपतडागानां शुद्धिश्चान्द्रायणं स्मृतं //
173.m: In the case of stealing humans, women, fields, houses, / or cisterns, wells, and reservoirs, the cāndrāyaṇa is remembered as the purification.

173.s:
bhakṣyabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyāsanasya ca /
puṣpamūlaphalānāñca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanaṃ //
173.d:
भक्ष्यभोज्यापहरणे यानशय्यासनस्य च /
पुष्पमूलफलानाञ्च पञ्चगव्यं विशोधनं //
173.m: In [the theft] of grass, wood, trees, dry food, and jaggery, / and of clothes, skins, or meat, there should be fasting for three nights.

173.s:
tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāñca śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca /
celacarmāmiṣāṇāñca trirātraṃ syādabhojanaṃ //
173.d:
तृणकाष्ठद्रुमाणाञ्च शुष्कान्नस्य गुडस्य च /
चेलचर्मामिषाणाञ्च त्रिरात्रं स्यादभोजनं //
173.m: Going to the father's wife, a sister, likewise a teacher's daughter, / the teacher's wife, or one's own daughter, one violates the guru's bed.

173.s:
pituḥ patnīñca bhaginīmācāryatanayāntathā /
ācāryāṇīṃ sutāṃ svāñca gacchaṃś ca gurutalpagaḥ //
173.d:
पितुः पत्नीञ्च भगिनीमाचार्यतनयान्तथा /
आचार्याणीं सुतां स्वाञ्च गच्छंश् च गुरुतल्पगः //
173.m: Having confessed the sin committed regarding the guru's bed, [he should lie] on a heated iron bed / and embrace a blazing iron pillar; through death he is purified.

173.s:
gurutalpe 'bhibhāṣyainastapte pacyādayomaye /
śūmīṃ jvalantīñcāśliṣya mṛtunā sa viśuddhyati //
173.d:
गुरुतल्पे ऽभिभाष्यैनस्तप्ते पच्यादयोमये /
शूमीं ज्वलन्तीञ्चाश्लिष्य मृतुना स विशुद्ध्यति //
173.m: Or, having performed the cāndrāyaṇa for three months, the violator of the guru's bed [is purified].

173.s:
cāndrāyaṇān vā trīnmāsānabhyasya gurutalpagaḥ /
:p 188
evameva vidhiṃ kuryād yoṣitsu patitāsvapi //
173.d:
चान्द्रायणान् वा त्रीन्मासानभ्यस्य गुरुतल्पगः /
:प् 188
एवमेव विधिं कुर्याद् योषित्सु पतितास्वपि //
173.m:
[Page 188]
One should apply this very rule also in the case of fallen women.
Whatever votive observance is prescribed for a man regarding another's wife, one should make her perform that; / having emitted semen into maidens, Cāṇḍāla women, or daughters,

173.s:
yat puṃsaḥ paradāreṣu taccaināṃ kārayedvrataṃ /
retaḥ siktvā kumārīṣu cāṇḍālīṣu sutāsu ca //
173.d:
यत् पुंसः परदारेषु तच्चैनां कारयेद्व्रतं /
रेतः सिक्त्वा कुमारीषु चाण्डालीषु सुतासु च //
173.m: or into the wives of sapinda relatives or offspring, giving up one's life is prescribed. / If a twice-born man frequents a Śūdra woman for one night,

173.s:
sapiṇḍāpatyadāreṣu prāṇatyāgo vidhīyate /
yat karotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanaṃ dvijaḥ //
173.d:
सपिण्डापत्यदारेषु प्राणत्यागो विधीयते /
यत् करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनं द्विजः //
173.m: eating begged food [and] reciting daily, he removes that [sin] in three years. / In approaching the wife of a paternal uncle, or in approaching a brother's wife,

173.s:
tadbhaikṣyabhug(1) japannityaṃ tribhirvarṣair vyapohati /
pitṛvyadāragamane bhrātṛbhāryāgame(2) tathā //
173.d:
तद्भैक्ष्यभुग्(1) जपन्नित्यं त्रिभिर्वर्षैर् व्यपोहति /
पितृव्यदारगमने भ्रातृभार्यागमे(2) तथा //
173.m: or a Cāṇḍāla woman, a Pukkasa woman, a daughter-in-law, a sister, a female friend, / a maternal aunt, a paternal aunt, a woman entrusted [for safekeeping], a woman who has sought refuge,

173.s:
cāṇḍālīṃ pukkasīṃ vāpi snuṣāñca bhaginīṃ sakhīṃ /
mātuḥ pituḥ svasārañca nikṣiptāṃ śaraṇāgatāṃ //
173.d:
चाण्डालीं पुक्कसीं वापि स्नुषाञ्च भगिनीं सखीं /
मातुः पितुः स्वसारञ्च निक्षिप्तां शरणागतां //
173.m: a maternal uncle's wife, a sister, a woman of the same lineage, one longing for another, / the wife of a disciple, or the wife of a guru—having approached [her], he should perform the cāndrāyaṇa.

173.s:
mātulānīṃ svasārañca sagotrāmanyamicchatīṃ /
śiṣyabhāryāṃ gurorbhāryāṃ gatvā cāndrāyaṇañcaret //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe prāyaścittāni nāma trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 haviṣyabhugiti ga.. ,ṭa.. ca
2 mātṛjāyāgame iti ga.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 189
:ś atha catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāyaścittāni
173.d:
मातुलानीं स्वसारञ्च सगोत्रामन्यमिच्छतीं /
शिष्यभार्यां गुरोर्भार्यां गत्वा चान्द्रायणञ्चरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रायश्चित्तानि नाम त्रिसप्तत्यधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 हविष्यभुगिति ग.. ,ट.. च
2 मातृजायागमे इति ग.. , छ.. , ट.. च
:प् 189
:श् अथ चतुःसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रायश्चित्तानि
173.m:
Thus ends the one hundred seventy-third chapter, entitled 'Expiations', in the Mahāpurāṇa of Agni.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and seventy-third chapter, entitled 'Expiations'.
1 'Eating sacrificial food' in ga.. and ṭa..
2 'In approaching a mother's co-wife' in ga.., cha.., and ṭa..
[Page 189]
% Chapter
Expiations
Agni said: / The expiation for the omission of worship of the deity, the hermitage, and so forth [is now stated]: / when worship is omitted, one should recite [the mantra] one hundred and eight times, and perform twofold worship.

174.s:
agnir uvāca
devāśramārcanādīnāṃ prāyaścittantu lopataḥ /
pūjālope cāṣṭaśataṃ japeddviguṇapūjanaṃ //
174.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
देवाश्रमार्चनादीनां प्रायश्चित्तन्तु लोपतः /
पूजालोपे चाष्टशतं जपेद्द्विगुणपूजनं //
174.m: Having offered fire oblations with the mantras of the five Upaniṣads, [there should be] feeding of Brahmins. / When the deity is touched by a woman in childbed, an outcaste, or a menstruating woman, one should recite [the mantra] a hundred times.

174.s:
pañcopaniṣadair mantrair hutvā brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ /
sūtikāntyajakodakyāspṛṣṭe deve śataṃ japet(1) //
174.d:
पञ्चोपनिषदैर् मन्त्रैर् हुत्वा ब्राह्मणभोजनं /
सूतिकान्त्यजकोदक्यास्पृष्टे देवे शतं जपेत्(1) //
174.m: Worship [should be performed] with the five Upaniṣads, and the bath twofold; / Brahmins are to be fed. When the fire oblation is omitted, [one should perform] the fire oblation, bath, and likewise worship.

174.s:
pañcopaniṣadaiḥ pūjāṃ dviguṇaṃ snānameva ca /
viprabhojyaṃ homalope homasnānaṃ tathārcanaṃ //
174.d:
पञ्चोपनिषदैः पूजां द्विगुणं स्नानमेव च /
विप्रभोज्यं होमलोपे होमस्नानं तथार्चनं //
174.m: When the sacrificial offering is eaten by mice and the like, or infested with insects, / abandoning that portion alone and sprinkling [with water], one should worship the deity and the rest.

174.s:
homadravye mūṣikādyair bhakṣite kīṭasaṃyute /
tāvanmātraṃ parityajya prokṣya devādi pūjayet //
174.d:
होमद्रव्ये मूषिकाद्यैर् भक्षिते कीटसंयुते /
तावन्मात्रं परित्यज्य प्रोक्ष्य देवादि पूजयेत् //
174.m: Only the offering of sprouts that is cut or broken should be discarded; / when it has been touched by untouchables, its offering is to be in another vessel.

174.s:
aṅkurārpaṇamātrantu chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ parityajet /
aspṛśyaiś caiva saṃspṛṣṭe anyapātre tadarpaṇaṃ //
174.d:
अङ्कुरार्पणमात्रन्तु छिन्नं भिन्नं परित्यजेत् /
अस्पृश्यैश् चैव संस्पृष्टे अन्यपात्रे तदर्पणं //
174.m: [This] destroys divine and human obstacles at the time of worship likewise. / In the case of an inversion of mantras, ritual substances, and the like, having recited the root mantra, one should recite again.

174.s:
devamānuṣavighnaghnaṃ pūjākāle tathaiva ca /
mantradravyādivyatyāse mūlaṃ japtvā punarjapet //
174.d:
देवमानुषविघ्नघ्नं पूजाकाले तथैव च /
मन्त्रद्रव्यादिव्यत्यासे मूलं जप्त्वा पुनर्जपेत् //
174.m: There is recitation of a hundred and eight [mantras] with a pot when the deity has fallen from the hand; / when it is broken or lost, there is fasting, and through a hundred fire oblations good fortune shall come to be.

174.s:
kumbhenāṣṭaśatajapo deve tu patite karāt /
bhinne naṣṭe copavāsaḥ śatahomācchubhaṃ bhavet(2) //
:n
1 śataṃ śahunediti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 śatahomācchucirbhavediti kha.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
:p 190
174.d:
कुम्भेनाष्टशतजपो देवे तु पतिते करात् /
भिन्ने नष्टे चोपवासः शतहोमाच्छुभं भवेत्(2) //
:न्
1 शतं शहुनेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
2 शतहोमाच्छुचिर्भवेदिति ख.. , घ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 190
174.m:
If a deity drops from one's hand, one should recite one hundred and eight [mantras] with a jar; / if it is broken or lost, there should be a fast, and good fortune arises from a hundred fire oblations.
1 'He should recite a hundred times' in kha.. and cha..
2 'Through a hundred fire oblations one becomes pure' in kha.., gha.., and ña..
[Page 190]
When remorse arises in a man after a sin has been committed, / the single, supreme expiation for him is the remembrance of Hari.

174.s:
kṛte pāpe 'nutāpo vai yasya puṃsaḥ prajāyate /
prāyaścittantu tasyaikaṃ harisaṃsmaraṇaṃ paraṃ //
174.d:
कृते पापे ऽनुतापो वै यस्य पुंसः प्रजायते /
प्रायश्चित्तन्तु तस्यैकं हरिसंस्मरणं परं //
174.m: The cāndrāyaṇa, the parāka, or the prājāpatya dispels the multitude of sins; / the recitation of the mantras of Sūrya, Īśa, Śakti, the Lord of Śrī, and others dispels the multitude of sins.

174.s:
cāndrāyaṇaṃ parāko vā prājāpatyamaghaughanut /
sūryeśaśaktiśrīśadimantrajapyamaghaughanut //
174.d:
चान्द्रायणं पराको वा प्राजापत्यमघौघनुत् /
सूर्येशशक्तिश्रीशदिमन्त्रजप्यमघौघनुत् //
174.m: The recitation of the Gāyatrī, the Praṇava, hymns of praise, and mantras destroys sins; / combined with the seed syllables beginning with ka and ending with them,

174.s:
gāyatrīpraṇavastotramantrajapyamaghāntakaṃ /
kādyair āvījasaṃyuktair ādyair ādyaistadantakaiḥ //
174.d:
गायत्रीप्रणवस्तोत्रमन्त्रजप्यमघान्तकं /
काद्यैर् आवीजसंयुक्तैर् आद्यैर् आद्यैस्तदन्तकैः //
174.m: the mantras of Sūrya, Īśa, Śakti, the Lord of Śrī, and others, numbered separately in more than crores, / beginning with 'Oṃ Hrīm', ending in the dative case, and concluding with 'namaḥ', grant all desires.

174.s:
sūryeśaśaktiśrīśādimantrāḥ koṭyadhikāḥ pṛthak /
oṃhrīmādyāś caturthyantā namontāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ //
174.d:
सूर्येशशक्तिश्रीशादिमन्त्राः कोट्यधिकाः पृथक् /
ओंह्रीमाद्याश् चतुर्थ्यन्ता नमोन्ताः सर्वकामदाः //
174.m: The garland-mantra and others of the twelve- and eight-syllabled [mantras] of Nṛsiṃha dispel the multitude of sins; / reading, hearing, and the like of the Purāṇa of Agni [also does].

174.s:
nṛsiṃhadvādaśāṣṭārṇamālāmantrādyaghaughanut /
āgneyasya purāṇasya paṭhanaṃ śravaṇādikaṃ //
174.d:
नृसिंहद्वादशाष्टार्णमालामन्त्राद्यघौघनुत् /
आग्नेयस्य पुराणस्य पठनं श्रवणादिकं //
174.m: Viṣṇu, possessing the form of two kinds of knowledge, is sung of as having the form of Agni; / the Supreme Self, the mouth of the gods, is sung of in all the Vedas.

174.s:
dvividyārūpako viṣṇuragnirūpastu gīyate /
paramātmā devamukhaṃ sarvavedeṣu gīyate //
174.d:
द्विविद्यारूपको विष्णुरग्निरूपस्तु गीयते /
परमात्मा देवमुखं सर्ववेदेषु गीयते //
174.m: In worldly activity and in renunciation He is worshipped, bestowing worldly enjoyment and liberation; / the fire offering, meditation, and worship of Viṣṇu in the form of Agni,

174.s:
pravṛttau tu nivṛttau tu ijyate bhuktimuktidaḥ(1) /
agnirūpasya viṣṇorhi havanaṃ dhyānamarcanaṃ //
174.d:
प्रवृत्तौ तु निवृत्तौ तु इज्यते भुक्तिमुक्तिदः(1) /
अग्निरूपस्य विष्णोर्हि हवनं ध्यानमर्चनं //
174.m: recitation, praise, and prostration destroy the entire multitude of sins of the body. / The ten gifts of gold, the twelve gifts of grain,

174.s:
japyaṃ stutiś ca praṇatiḥ śārīrāśeṣāghaughanut /
daśasvarṇāni dānāni dhānyadvādaśameva ca //
174.d:
जप्यं स्तुतिश् च प्रणतिः शारीराशेषाघौघनुत् /
दशस्वर्णानि दानानि धान्यद्वादशमेव च //
174.m: the sixteen great gifts chief among which is the Tulāpuruṣa, / and gifts of food are foremost—all indeed remove sins.

174.s:
tulāpuruṣamukhyāni mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa /
annadānāni mukhyāni sarvāṇyaghaharāṇi hi //
174.d:
तुलापुरुषमुख्यानि महादानानि षोडश /
अन्नदानानि मुख्यानि सर्वाण्यघहराणि हि //
174.m: At the times of lunar days, weekdays, lunar mansions, solar transitions, planetary yogas, beginnings of manvantaras, and the like, / a votive observance and so forth to Sūrya, Īśa, Śakti, the Lord of Śrī, and others destroys sins.

174.s:
tithivārarkṣasaṅkrāntiyogamanvādikālake /
bratādi sūryeśaśaktiśrīśāderaghaghātanaṃ(2) //
174.d:
तिथिवारर्क्षसङ्क्रान्तियोगमन्वादिकालके /
ब्रतादि सूर्येशशक्तिश्रीशादेरघघातनं(2) //
174.m: The Gaṅgā, Gayā, Prayāga, Kāśī, Ayodhyā, and Avantikā,

174.s:
gaṅgā gayā prayāgaś ca kāśyayodhyā hy avamtikā /
:n
1 pravṛttaistu nivṛttaistu ijyate bhuktimuktida iti gha.. , ṅa.. , jha.. , ña..
ca
2 aghanāśanamiti ga..
:p 191
kurukṣetraṃ puṣkarañca naimiṣaṃ puruṣottamaḥ //
174.d:
गङ्गा गया प्रयागश् च काश्ययोध्या ह्य् अवम्तिका /
:न्
1 प्रवृत्तैस्तु निवृत्तैस्तु इज्यते भुक्तिमुक्तिद इति घ.. , ङ.. , झ.. , ञ..
च
2 अघनाशनमिति ग..
:प् 191
कुरुक्षेत्रं पुष्करञ्च नैमिषं पुरुषोत्तमः //
174.m:
Gaṅgā, Gayā, Prayāga, Kāśī, Ayodhyā, and Avantikā—
1 'He is worshipped, bestowing worldly enjoyment and liberation' in gha.., ṅa.., jha.., and ña..
2 'Destruction of sins' in ga..
[Page 191]
Kurukṣetra, Puṣkara, Naimiṣa, Puruṣottama,
sacred fords such as Śālagrāma and Prabhāsa destroy the multitude of sins; / the meditation 'I am Brahman, the supreme light' dispels the multitude of sins.

174.s:
śālagrāmaprabhāsādyaṃ tīrthañcaghoghaghātakaṃ /
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiriti dhyānamaghaughanut //
174.d:
शालग्रामप्रभासाद्यं तीर्थञ्चघोघघातकं /
अहं ब्रह्म परं ज्योतिरिति ध्यानमघौघनुत् //
174.m: The Purāṇa of Agni is Brahman, [and so are] Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara; / the incarnations, all acts of worship, consecration, images, and the like,

174.s:
purāṇaṃ brahma cāgneyaṃ brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ /
avatārāḥ sarvapūjāḥ pratiṣṭhāpratimādikaṃ //
174.d:
पुराणं ब्रह्म चाग्नेयं ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्महेश्वरः /
अवताराः सर्वपूजाः प्रतिष्ठाप्रतिमादिकं //
174.m: astronomy and astrology, the Purāṇas, the Smṛtis, ascetic austerity, and votive observance, / polity, creation and the rest, Āyurveda, the science of archery,

174.s:
jyotiḥśāstrapurāṇāni smṛtayastu tapovrataṃ(1) /
arthaśāstrañca sargādyā āyurvedo dhanurmatiḥ //
174.d:
ज्योतिःशास्त्रपुराणानि स्मृतयस्तु तपोव्रतं(1) /
अर्थशास्त्रञ्च सर्गाद्या आयुर्वेदो धनुर्मतिः //
174.m: phonetics, metre, grammar, etymology, lexicography, / ritual manuals, logic, and Mīmāṃsā—everything else is Lord Hari.

174.s:
śikṣā chando vyākaraṇaṃ niruktañcābhidhānakaṃ /
kalpo nyāyaś ca mīmāṃsā hy anyat sarvaṃ hariḥ prabhuḥ //
174.d:
शिक्षा छन्दो व्याकरणं निरुक्तञ्चाभिधानकं /
कल्पो न्यायश् च मीमांसा ह्य् अन्यत् सर्वं हरिः प्रभुः //
174.m: He who knows that in the One, in the two, from whom, in whom, and who is everything— / seeing him, another's sins are destroyed, and he is Hari.

174.s:
eke dvayoryato yasmin yaḥ sarvamiti veda yaḥ /
taṃ dṛṣṭvānyasya pāpāni vinaśyanti hariś ca saḥ //
174.d:
एके द्वयोर्यतो यस्मिन् यः सर्वमिति वेद यः /
तं दृष्ट्वान्यस्य पापानि विनश्यन्ति हरिश् च सः //
174.m: Possessing the form of the eighteen branches of learning, subtle, gross, and beyond is Hari; / He is the light, the true, the imperishable supreme Brahman, Viṣṇu, stainless.

174.s:
vidyāṣṭādaśarūpaś ca sūkṣmaḥ sthūlo 'paro hariḥ /
jyotiḥ sadakṣaraṃ brahma paraṃ viṣṇuś ca nirmalaḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe prāyaścittāni nāma
catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcasaptyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vrataparibhāṣā
174.d:
विद्याष्टादशरूपश् च सूक्ष्मः स्थूलो ऽपरो हरिः /
ज्योतिः सदक्षरं ब्रह्म परं विष्णुश् च निर्मलः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रायश्चित्तानि नाम
चतुःसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चसप्त्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
व्रतपरिभाषा
174.m:
Thus ends the one hundred seventy-fourth chapter, entitled 'Expiations', in the Mahāpurāṇa of Agni.
% Chapter
Definition of Votive Observance
Agni said: / At the conjunction of a lunar day, weekday, lunar mansion, day, month, season, year, or sun, / I shall proclaim the votive observances and so forth for men and women in their order; listen, O Vasiṣṭha.

175.s:
agnir uvāca
tithivārarkṣadivasamāsartvabdārkasaṅkrame /
nṛstrīvratādi(2) vakṣyāmi vasiṣṭha śṛṇu tat kramāt //
:n
1 smṛtayaḥ śrutayo vratamiti ka.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca / ahaṃ
brahmetyādiḥ, tapovratamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ga.. pustake nāsti
2 puṃstrī vratādīti ṅa.. , ña.. ca
:p 192
175.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
तिथिवारर्क्षदिवसमासर्त्वब्दार्कसङ्क्रमे /
नृस्त्रीव्रतादि(2) वक्ष्यामि वसिष्ठ शृणु तत् क्रमात् //
:न्
1 स्मृतयः श्रुतयो व्रतमिति क.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च / अहं
ब्रह्मेत्यादिः, तपोव्रतमित्यन्तः पाठः ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 पुंस्त्री व्रतादीति ङ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 192
175.m:
Agni said: / According to the lunar day, weekday, asterism, solar day, month, season, year, and solar transit, / I shall proclaim the votive observances and the like for men and women, O Vasiṣṭha; listen to them in order.
1 'The Smṛtis, the Śrutis, and votive observance' in ka.., gha.., ṅa.., and ña.. / The text beginning with 'I am Brahman' and ending with 'ascetic austerity and votive observance' is not found in the ga.. manuscript
2 'The votive observances and so forth for men and women' in ṅa.. and ña..
[Page 192]
A restriction prescribed by scripture is indeed a votive observance, and that is considered ascetic austerity; / the restrictions are the specific [practices] of the votive observance itself, such as self-restraint.

175.s:
śāstrodito hi niyamo vrataṃ tacca tapo mataṃ /
niyamāstu viśeṣāstu vratasyaiva damādayaḥ //
175.d:
शास्त्रोदितो हि नियमो व्रतं तच्च तपो मतं /
नियमास्तु विशेषास्तु व्रतस्यैव दमादयः //
175.m: A votive observance is called ascetic austerity on account of the torment of the performer; / and it is called a restriction on account of the restraint of the aggregate of the senses.

175.s:
vrataṃ hi kartṛsantāpāttapa ity abhidhīyate /
indriyagrāmaniyamānniyamaścābhidhīyate //
175.d:
व्रतं हि कर्तृसन्तापात्तप इत्य् अभिधीयते /
इन्द्रियग्रामनियमान्नियमश्चाभिधीयते //
175.m: A votive observance is called ascetic austerity because it burns away [sins] from the performer; / and it is called a restraint because of the restraint of the collection of senses.

175.s:
anagnayastu ye viprāsteṣāṃ śreyo 'bhidhīyate /
vratopavāsaniyamair nānādānais tathā dvijaḥ //
175.d:
अनग्नयस्तु ये विप्रास्तेषां श्रेयो ऽभिधीयते /
व्रतोपवासनियमैर् नानादानैस् तथा द्विजः //
175.m: The spiritual welfare of those Brahmins who keep no sacrificial fires is proclaimed: / by votive observances, fasts, and restraints, and likewise by various gifts, the twice-born

175.s:
te syurdevādayaḥ(1) prītā bhuktimuktipradāyakāḥ /
upāvṛttasya pāpebhyo yastu vāso guṇaiḥ saha //
175.d:
ते स्युर्देवादयः(1) प्रीता भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकाः /
उपावृत्तस्य पापेभ्यो यस्तु वासो गुणैः सह //
175.m: causes the gods and others to become pleased, bestowing worldly enjoyment and liberation. / The dwelling with virtues of one who has turned away from sins—

175.s:
upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ(2) /
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrañca caṇakaṃ koradūṣakaṃ //
175.d:
उपवासः स विज्ञेयः सर्वभोगविवर्जितः(2) /
कांस्यं मांसं मसूरञ्च चणकं कोरदूषकं //
175.m: that is to be known as a fast, devoid of all worldly pleasures. / Bell-metal, meat, lentils, chickpeas, kodo millet,

175.s:
śākaṃ madhu parānnañca(3) tyajedupavasan striyaṃ /
puṣpālaṅkāravastrāṇi dhūpagandhanulepanaṃ //
175.d:
शाकं मधु परान्नञ्च(3) त्यजेदुपवसन् स्त्रियं /
पुष्पालङ्कारवस्त्राणि धूपगन्धनुलेपनं //
175.m: vegetables, honey, another's food, and a woman should be avoided while fasting; / flowers, ornaments, garments, incense, fragrant pastes, and ungents,

175.s:
upavāse na śasyanti dantadhāvanamañjanaṃ /
dantakāṣṭhaṃ pañcagavyaṃ kṛtvā prātarvratañcaret //
175.d:
उपवासे न शस्यन्ति दन्तधावनमञ्जनं /
दन्तकाष्ठं पञ्चगव्यं कृत्वा प्रातर्व्रतञ्चरेत् //
175.m: brushing the teeth, and collyrium are not recommended during a fast. / Having used a tooth-stick and [consumed] the five products of the cow, one should observe the votive observance in the morning.

175.s:
asakṛjjalapānācca tāmbūlasya ca bhakṣaṇāt /
upavāsaḥ praduṣyeta divāsvapnācca maithunāt //
175.d:
असकृज्जलपानाच्च ताम्बूलस्य च भक्षणात् /
उपवासः प्रदुष्येत दिवास्वप्नाच्च मैथुनात् //
175.m: A fast is corrupted by repeatedly drinking water, / eating betel, sleeping by day, and sexual intercourse.

175.s:
kṣamā satyandayā dānaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ /
devapūjāgniharaṇaṃ(4) santoṣo 'steyameva ca //
175.d:
क्षमा सत्यन्दया दानं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः /
देवपूजाग्निहरणं(4) सन्तोषो ऽस्तेयमेव च //
175.m: Patience, truthfulness, compassion, gift-giving, ritual purity, restraint of the senses, / worship of the gods, taking fire, contentment, and non-stealing—

175.s:
sarvavrateṣvayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo daśadhā smṛtaḥ /
pavitrāṇi japeccaiva juhuyāccaiva śaktitaḥ //
:n
1 taiḥ syurdevādaya iti ga.. , cha.. ca
2 sarvapāpavivarjita iti ja.. , jha.. ca / sarvataḥ parivarjita iti cha..
3 śākaṃ dadhi parānnañceti kha.. , cha.. ca
4 devapūjāgnihavanamiti gha.. , ṭa.. ca
175.d:
सर्वव्रतेष्वयं धर्मः सामान्यो दशधा स्मृतः /
पवित्राणि जपेच्चैव जुहुयाच्चैव शक्तितः //
:न्
1 तैः स्युर्देवादय इति ग.. , छ.. च
2 सर्वपापविवर्जित इति ज.. , झ.. च / सर्वतः परिवर्जित इति छ..
3 शाकं दधि परान्नञ्चेति ख.. , छ.. च
4 देवपूजाग्निहवनमिति घ.. , ट.. च
175.m:
this tenfold righteousness is remembered as common to all votive observances. / One should also recite purifying [mantras] and make offerings in fire according to one's capacity.
[Footnote]
1. 'taiḥ syurdevādayaḥ' in manuscripts ga and cha.
2. 'sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ' in manuscripts ja and jha; 'sarvataḥ parivarjitaḥ' in manuscript cha.
3. 'śākaṃ dadhi parānnañca' in manuscripts kha and cha.
4. 'devapūjāgnihavanam' in manuscripts gha and ṭa.

175.s:
nityasnāyī mitāhāro(1) gurudevadvijārcakaḥ /
kṣāraṃ kṣaudrañca lavaṇaṃ madhu māṃsāni varjayet //
175.d:
नित्यस्नायी मिताहारो(1) गुरुदेवद्विजार्चकः /
क्षारं क्षौद्रञ्च लवणं मधु मांसानि वर्जयेत् //
175.m: Bathing daily, temperate in food, worshipping guru, gods, and twice-born, / one should avoid alkaline substances, honey, salt, liquor, and meat.

175.s:
tilamudgādṛte śasyaṃ śasye godhūmakodravau /
cīnakaṃ devadhānyañca śamīdhānyaṃ tathaikṣavaṃ(2) //
175.d:
तिलमुद्गादृते शस्यं शस्ये गोधूमकोद्रवौ /
चीनकं देवधान्यञ्च शमीधान्यं तथैक्षवं(2) //
175.m: Apart from sesame and mung beans, grain is [suitable]; among grain, wheat and kodo millet, / broomcorn millet, wild rice, leguminous grains, and sugarcane products,

175.s:
śitadhānyaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ mūlaṃ kṣāragaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ /
vrīhiṣaṣṭikamudgāś ca kalāyāḥ satilā yavāḥ //
175.d:
शितधान्यं तथा पुण्यं मूलं क्षारगणः स्मृतः /
व्रीहिषष्टिकमुद्गाश् च कलायाः सतिला यवाः //
175.m: white rice, and sacred roots are considered a group of alkaline substances. / Rice, sixty-day rice, mung beans, peas, barley with sesame,

175.s:
śyāmākāś caiva nīvārā godhūmādyā vrate hitāḥ /
kuṣmāṇḍālāvuvārtākūn pālaṅkīmpūtikāntyajet //
175.d:
श्यामाकाश् चैव नीवारा गोधूमाद्या व्रते हिताः /
कुष्माण्डालावुवार्ताकून् पालङ्कीम्पूतिकान्त्यजेत् //
175.m: śyāmāka grain, wild rice, wheat, and the like are beneficial during a votive observance. / One should avoid pumpkin, bottle gourd, eggplant, spinach, and pūtikā.

175.s:
carubhaikṣyaṃ śaktukaṇāḥ śākandadhi ghṛtaṃ payaḥ /
śyāmākaśālinīvārā yavakaṃ mūlataṇḍulaṃ //
175.d:
चरुभैक्ष्यं शक्तुकणाः शाकन्दधि घृतं पयः /
श्यामाकशालिनीवारा यवकं मूलतण्डुलं //
175.m: Sacrificial porridge, alms-food, groats, broken grain, vegetables, curds, clarified butter, milk, / śyāmāka, winter rice, wild rice, barley porridge, and root-rice:

175.s:
haviṣyaṃ vratanaktādāvagnikāryādike hitaṃ /
madhu māṃsaṃ vihāyānyad vrate vā hitamīritaṃ //
175.d:
हविष्यं व्रतनक्तादावग्निकार्यादिके हितं /
मधु मांसं विहायान्यद् व्रते वा हितमीरितं //
175.m: this sacrificial food is beneficial in votive night-meals and the like, fire rites, and so forth; / anything other than honey and meat is stated to be beneficial in a votive observance.

175.s:
tryahaṃ prātastryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahamadyādayācitaṃ /
tryahamparañca nāśnīyāt prājāpatyañcaran dvijaḥ //
175.d:
त्र्यहं प्रातस्त्र्यहं सायं त्र्यहमद्यादयाचितं /
त्र्यहम्परञ्च नाश्नीयात् प्राजापत्यञ्चरन् द्विजः //
175.m: For three days in the morning, for three days in the evening, for three days eating unasked-for food, / and for another three days one should not eat: [thus] a twice-born performs the prājāpatya.

175.s:
ekaikaṃ grāsamaśnīyāt tryahāṇi trīṇi pūrvavat /
tryahañcopavasedantyamatikṛcchraṃ caran dvijaḥ //
175.d:
एकैकं ग्रासमश्नीयात् त्र्यहाणि त्रीणि पूर्ववत् /
त्र्यहञ्चोपवसेदन्त्यमतिकृच्छ्रं चरन् द्विजः //
175.m: He should eat a single mouthful [each day] for three periods of three days as before, / and should fast for the final three days: [thus] a twice-born performs the atikṛcchra.

175.s:
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakaṃ /
ekarātropavāsaś ca kṛcchraṃ śāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ //
175.d:
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकं /
एकरात्रोपवासश् च कृच्छ्रं शान्तपनं स्मृतं //
175.m: Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curds, clarified butter, kuśa water, / and fasting for one night: this is remembered as the śāntapana kṛcchra.

175.s:
pṛthak śāntapanadravyaiḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sopavāsakaḥ /
saptāhena tu kṛcchro 'yaṃ mahāśāntapano 'ghahā //
175.d:
पृथक् शान्तपनद्रव्यैः षडहः सोपवासकः /
सप्ताहेन तु कृच्छ्रो ऽयं महाशान्तपनो ऽघहा //
175.m: When each of the ingredients of the śāntapana is taken on separate days for six days, followed by a fast [on the seventh], / this seven-day kṛcchra is the mahāśāntapana, destroying sins.

175.s:
dvādaśāhopavāsena parākaḥ sarvapāpahā /
:n
1 yatāhāra iti gha..
2 śamīdhānyaṃ tathaiva ceti ga.. ,jha.. ca
:p 194
mahāparākastriguṇastvayameva prakīrtitaḥ //
175.d:
द्वादशाहोपवासेन पराकः सर्वपापहा /
:न्
1 यताहार इति घ..
2 शमीधान्यं तथैव चेति ग.. ,झ.. च
:प् 194
महापराकस्त्रिगुणस्त्वयमेव प्रकीर्तितः //
175.m:
The parāka, which destroys all sins, consists of a fast of twelve days.
[Footnote]
1. 'yatāhāraḥ' in manuscript gha.
2. 'śamīdhānyaṃ tathaiva ca' in manuscripts ga and jha.
The mahāparāka is proclaimed to be simply this [period] multiplied by three.

175.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ pañcadaśagrāsyamāvāsyabhojanaḥ /
ekāpāye tato vṛddhau cāndrāyaṇamato 'nyathā //
175.d:
पौर्णमास्यां पञ्चदशग्रास्यमावास्यभोजनः /
एकापाये ततो वृद्धौ चान्द्रायणमतो ऽन्यथा //
175.m: One eats fifteen mouthfuls on the full moon day, and [nothing] on the new moon day, / decreasing by one [mouthful per day] and then increasing: this is the cāndrāyaṇa; otherwise [it is inverted].

175.s:
kapilāgoḥ palaṃ mūtraṃ ardhāṅguṣṭhañca gomayaṃ /
kṣīraṃ saptapalandadyāt dadhnaś caiva paladvayaṃ(1) //
175.d:
कपिलागोः पलं मूत्रं अर्धाङ्गुष्ठञ्च गोमयं /
क्षीरं सप्तपलन्दद्यात् दध्नश् चैव पलद्वयं(1) //
175.m: One should offer one pala of urine of a tawny cow, cow dung the size of half a thumb, / seven palas of milk, and two palas of curds,

175.s:
ghṛtamekapalandadyāt palamekaṃ kuśodakaṃ /
gayatryā gṛhya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayaṃ //
175.d:
घृतमेकपलन्दद्यात् पलमेकं कुशोदकं /
गयत्र्या गृह्य गोमूत्रं गन्धद्वारेति गोमयं //
175.m: one pala of clarified butter, and one pala of kuśa water: / taking the cow urine with the Gāyatrī, the cow dung with 'gandhadvārā...',

175.s:
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi /
tejo 'sīti tathā cājyaṃ devasyeti kuśodakaṃ(2) //
175.d:
आप्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णेति वै दधि /
तेजो ऽसीति तथा चाज्यं देवस्येति कुशोदकं(2) //
175.m: the milk with 'āpyāyasva...', the curds with 'dadhikrāvṇo...', / the clarified butter with 'tejo 'si...', and the kuśa water with 'devasya...'.

175.s:
brahmakūrco bhavatyevaṃ āpo hiṣṭhetyṛcaṃ japet /
aghamarṣaṇasūktena saṃyojya praṇavena vā //
175.d:
ब्रह्मकूर्चो भवत्येवं आपो हिष्ठेत्यृचं जपेत् /
अघमर्षणसूक्तेन संयोज्य प्रणवेन वा //
175.m: Such is the brahmakūrca. One should recite the verse 'āpo hi ṣṭhā...', / combining it with the aghamarṣaṇa hymn or with the praṇava.

175.s:
pītvā sarvāghanirmukto viṣṇulokī hy upoṣitaḥ /
upavāsī sāyambhojī yatiḥ ṣaṣṭhātmakālavān //
175.d:
पीत्वा सर्वाघनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकी ह्य् उपोषितः /
उपवासी सायम्भोजी यतिः षष्ठात्मकालवान् //
175.m: Having drunk it, freed from all sin, having fasted, one attains the realm of Viṣṇu. / One who fasts, one who eats in the evening, an ascetic, one who eats only at every sixth mealtime,

175.s:
māṃsavarjī cāśvamedhī satyavādī divaṃ vrajet /
agnyādheyaṃ pratiṣṭhāñca yajñadānavratāni ca //
175.d:
मांसवर्जी चाश्वमेधी सत्यवादी दिवं व्रजेत् /
अग्न्याधेयं प्रतिष्ठाञ्च यज्ञदानव्रतानि च //
175.m: one who abstains from meat, one who performs the horse sacrifice, and one who speaks the truth goes to heaven. / The installation of sacred fires, consecration, sacrifices, gifts, and votive observances,

175.s:
devavratavṛṣotsargacūḍākaraṇamekhalāḥ /
māṅgalyamabhiṣekañca malamāse vivarjayet //
175.d:
देवव्रतवृषोत्सर्गचूडाकरणमेखलाः /
माङ्गल्यमभिषेकञ्च मलमासे विवर्जयेत् //
175.m: votive observances for deities, release of a bull, tonsure ceremony, investiture with the sacred girdle, / auspicious ceremonies, and consecration by aspersion should be avoided in an intercalary month.

175.s:
darśāddarśastu cāndraḥ syāt triṃśāhaś caiva bhāvanaḥ /
māsaḥ saurastu saṅkrānternākṣatro bhavivartanāt //
175.d:
दर्शाद्दर्शस्तु चान्द्रः स्यात् त्रिंशाहश् चैव भावनः /
मासः सौरस्तु सङ्क्रान्तेर्नाक्षत्रो भविवर्तनात् //
175.m: The lunar month is from new moon to new moon; the civil month is thirty days; / the solar month is from solar transit [to transit]; the sidereal month is from the moon's revolution through the asterisms.

175.s:
sauro māso vivāhādau yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ(3) /
:n
1 dadhnaś caiva palatrayamiti gha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
2 gāyatryā ity ādiḥ, kuśodakamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake
nāsti
3 sāvano mata iti cha..
:p 195
āvdhike pitṛkārye ca cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate //
175.d:
सौरो मासो विवाहादौ यज्ञादौ सावनः स्मृतः(3) /
:न्
1 दध्नश् चैव पलत्रयमिति घ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
2 गायत्र्या इत्य् आदिः, कुशोदकमित्यन्तः पाठः छ.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
3 सावनो मत इति छ..
:प् 195
आव्धिके पितृकार्ये च चान्द्रो मासः प्रशस्यते //
175.m:
The solar month is prescribed for marriage and the like; the civil month for sacrifices and the like;
[Footnote]
1. 'dadhnaś caiva palatrayam' in manuscripts gha, ña, and ṭa.
2. The text from 'gāyatryā' up to 'kuśodakam' is absent in manuscript cha.
3. 'sāvano mataḥ' in manuscript cha.
and the lunar month is commended for annual ancestral rites.

175.s:
āṣāḍhīmavadhiṃ kṛtvā yaḥ syātpakṣastu pañcamaḥ /
kuryācchrāddhantatra raviḥ kanyāṃ gacchatu vā na vā //
175.d:
आषाढीमवधिं कृत्वा यः स्यात्पक्षस्तु पञ्चमः /
कुर्याच्छ्राद्धन्तत्र रविः कन्यां गच्छतु वा न वा //
175.m: Taking the full moon of Āṣāḍha as the limit, in whichever fortnight is the fifth, / one should perform ancestral rites there, whether the sun enters Virgo or not.

175.s:
māsi saṃvatsare caiva tithidvaidhaṃ yadā bhavet /
tatrottarottamā jñeyā pūrvā tu syān malimlucā //
175.d:
मासि संवत्सरे चैव तिथिद्वैधं यदा भवेत् /
तत्रोत्तरोत्तमा ज्ञेया पूर्वा तु स्यान् मलिम्लुचा //
175.m: In a month and in a year, whenever there is a conflict of lunar days, / the subsequent one is to be known as the best, while the earlier one is considered tainted.

175.s:
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ yenāstaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ /
divā puṇyāstu tithayo rātrau naktavrate śubhāḥ //
175.d:
उपोषितव्यं नक्षत्रं येनास्तं याति भास्करः /
दिवा पुण्यास्तु तिथयो रात्रौ नक्तव्रते शुभाः //
175.m: The asterism during which the sun sets should be kept for fasting; / lunar days are auspicious by day, and in night-fasting observances they are auspicious at night.

175.s:
yugmāgnikṛtabhūtāni(1) ṣaṇmunyorvasurandhrayoḥ /
rudreṇa dvādaśo yuktā caturdaśyātha(2) pūrṇimā //
175.d:
युग्माग्निकृतभूतानि(1) षण्मुन्योर्वसुरन्ध्रयोः /
रुद्रेण द्वादशो युक्ता चतुर्दश्याथ(2) पूर्णिमा //
175.m: [The combinations of] two and three, four and five, six and seven, eight and nine, / twelve joined with eleven, and the full moon with the fourteenth,

175.s:
pratipadā tvamāvāsyā tithyoryugmaṃ mahāphalaṃ /
etadvyastaṃ mahāghoraṃ hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtaṃ //
175.d:
प्रतिपदा त्वमावास्या तिथ्योर्युग्मं महाफलं /
एतद्व्यस्तं महाघोरं हन्ति पुण्यं पुराकृतं //
175.m: and the new moon with the first lunar day—such a pair of lunar days yields great fruit. / The reverse of this is exceedingly terrible and destroys merit earned in the past.

175.s:
narendramantrivratināṃ(3) vivāhopadravādiṣu /
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ kāntārāpadi saṃṣadi //
175.d:
नरेन्द्रमन्त्रिव्रतिनां(3) विवाहोपद्रवादिषु /
सद्यः शौचं समाख्यातं कान्तारापदि संषदि //
175.m: For kings, ministers, and those engaged in a votive observance, in marriage, calamity, and similar crises, / in the perils of the forest, or in an assembly, immediate ritual purity is proclaimed.

175.s:
ārabdhadīrghatapasāṃ na rājā vratahā striyāḥ /
garbhiṇī sūtikā naktaṃ kumārī ca rajasvalā //
175.d:
आरब्धदीर्घतपसां न राजा व्रतहा स्त्रियाः /
गर्भिणी सूतिका नक्तं कुमारी च रजस्वला //
175.m: For those who have commenced long ascetic austerities, the king cannot terminate the votive observance. For women— / a pregnant woman, a woman in childbed, one observing a night fast, an unmarried girl, or a menstruating woman—

175.s:
yadāśuddhā tadānyena kārayeta kriyāḥ sadā /
krodhāt pramādāllobhādvā vratabhaṅgo bhavedyadi //
175.d:
यदाशुद्धा तदान्येन कारयेत क्रियाः सदा /
क्रोधात् प्रमादाल्लोभाद्वा व्रतभङ्गो भवेद्यदि //
175.m: whenever she is impure, she should always have the rites performed by another. / If a breach of the votive observance should occur through anger, negligence, or greed,

175.s:
dinatrayaṃ na bhuññīta muṇḍanaṃ śiraso 'tha vā /
asāmarthye vratakṛtau patnīṃ vā kārayet sutaṃ //
175.d:
दिनत्रयं न भुञ्ञीत मुण्डनं शिरसो ऽथ वा /
असामर्थ्ये व्रतकृतौ पत्नीं वा कारयेत् सुतं //
175.m: one should fast for three days, or else shave the head. / In case of incapacity to perform the votive observance, one may have one's wife or son perform it.

175.s:
sūtake mṛtake kārtyaṃ prārabdhaṃ pūjanojjhitaṃ /
vratasthaṃ mūrchitaṃ dugdhapānādyair uddhared guruḥ //
:n
1 yugmāgniyugabhūtānīti ja.. , jha.. ca
