2 caturdaśyā ceti ga..
3 narendrasatrivratināmiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 196
175.d:
सूतके मृतके कार्त्यं प्रारब्धं पूजनोज्झितं /
व्रतस्थं मूर्छितं दुग्धपानाद्यैर् उद्धरेद् गुरुः //
:न्
1 युग्माग्नियुगभूतानीति ज.. , झ.. च
2 चतुर्दश्या चेति ग..
3 नरेन्द्रसत्रिव्रतिनामिति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 196
175.m:
During birth impurity or death impurity, an observance that has been begun should be carried out without worship. / If an observer of a vow faints, the guru should revive him by giving him milk to drink or the like.
[Footnote]
1. "yugmāgniyugabhūtāni" in ja and jha.
2. "caturdaśyā ca" in ga.
3. "narendrasatrivratinām" in kha, gha, ja, and ña. / Page 196.

175.s:
aṣtau tānyavrataghnāni āpo mūlaṃ phalaṃ payaḥ /
havirbrāhmaṇakāmyā ca gurorvacanamauṣadhaṃ //
175.d:
अष्तौ तान्यव्रतघ्नानि आपो मूलं फलं पयः /
हविर्ब्राह्मणकाम्या च गुरोर्वचनमौषधं //
175.m: These eight do not break a votive observance: water, roots, fruits, milk, / sacrificial butter, what is desired by a brāhmaṇa, the guru's word, and medicine.

175.s:
kīrtisantatividyādisaubhāgyārogyavṛddhaye /
nairmalyabhuktimuktyarthaṃ kurve vratapate vrataṃ //
175.d:
कीर्तिसन्ततिविद्यादिसौभाग्यारोग्यवृद्धये /
नैर्मल्यभुक्तिमुक्त्यर्थं कुर्वे व्रतपते व्रतं //
175.m: "For the increase of fame, lineage, learning and the like, good fortune, and health, / and for purity, worldly enjoyment, and liberation, I undertake this votive observance, O Lord of vows!

175.s:
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhītaṃ puratastava /
nirvighnāṃ siddhimāyātu tvatprasādāt jagatpate //
175.d:
इदं व्रतं मया श्रेष्ठं गृहीतं पुरतस्तव /
निर्विघ्नां सिद्धिमायातु त्वत्प्रसादात् जगत्पते //
175.m: This excellent votive observance has been undertaken by me in your presence; / may it attain obstacle-free fulfillment by your grace, O Lord of the universe!

175.s:
gṛhīte 'smin vratavare(1) yadyapūrṇe mriye hy ahaṃ /
tatsarvaṃ pūrṇamevāstu prasanne tvayi satpatau //
175.d:
गृहीते ऽस्मिन् व्रतवरे(1) यद्यपूर्णे म्रिये ह्य् अहं /
तत्सर्वं पूर्णमेवास्तु प्रसन्ने त्वयि सत्पतौ //
175.m: If, this excellent votive observance having been undertaken, I should die before it is completed, / let all of it be entirely complete when you, O true Lord, are pleased!"

175.s:
vratamūrtiṃ jagadbhūtiṃ maṇḍale sarvasiddhaye /
āvahaye namastubhyaṃ sannidhībhava keśava //
175.d:
व्रतमूर्तिं जगद्भूतिं मण्डले सर्वसिद्धये /
आवहये नमस्तुभ्यं सन्निधीभव केशव //
175.m: "The icon of the votive observance, the prosperity of the world, I invoke in the maṇḍala for the attainment of all success. / Reverence to you! Be present here, O Keśava!

175.s:
manasā kalpitair bhaktyā pañcagavyair jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayāmi tvaṃ me ca bhava pāpahā //
175.d:
मनसा कल्पितैर् भक्त्या पञ्चगव्यैर् जलैः शुभैः /
पञ्चामृतैः स्नापयामि त्वं मे च भव पापहा //
175.m: With pure waters, with the five products of the cow, and with the five nectars conceived mentally with devotion / I bathe you; and do you become the destroyer of my sins!

175.s:
gandhapuṣpodakair yuktamarghyamarghyapate śubhaṃ /
gṛhāṇa pādyamācāmamarghyārhaṅkuru māṃ sadā //
175.d:
गन्धपुष्पोदकैर् युक्तमर्घ्यमर्घ्यपते शुभं /
गृहाण पाद्यमाचाममर्घ्यार्हङ्कुरु मां सदा //
175.m: O Lord of the water offering, accept the auspicious water offering endowed with perfume, flowers, and water, / as well as foot-washing water and sipping water; always make me worthy of the water offering!

175.s:
vastraṃ vastrapate puṇyaṃ gṛhāṇa kuru māṃ sadā /
bhūṣaṇādyaiḥ suvastrādyaiśchāditaṃ vratasatpate //
175.d:
वस्त्रं वस्त्रपते पुण्यं गृहाण कुरु मां सदा /
भूषणाद्यैः सुवस्त्राद्यैश्छादितं व्रतसत्पते //
175.m: O Lord of garments, accept this holy garment! Always keep me, / covered with fine garments, ornaments, and the like, O true Lord of the votive observance!

175.s:
sugandhigandhaṃ vimalaṃ gandhamūrte gṛhāṇa vai /
pāpagandhavihīnaṃ māṃ kuru tvaṃ hi sugandhikaṃ //
175.d:
सुगन्धिगन्धं विमलं गन्धमूर्ते गृहाण वै /
पापगन्धविहीनं मां कुरु त्वं हि सुगन्धिकं //
175.m: O icon of fragrance, accept this pure, fragrant scent; / make me fragrant indeed, freed from the foul odor of sin!

175.s:
puṣpaṃ gṛhāṇa puṣpādipūrṇa māṃ kuru sarvadā /
puṣpagandhaṃ suvimalaṃ āyurārogyavṛddhaye //
175.d:
पुष्पं गृहाण पुष्पादिपूर्ण मां कुरु सर्वदा /
पुष्पगन्धं सुविमलं आयुरारोग्यवृद्धये //
175.m: Accept this flower, and ever make me filled with flowers and [blessings]! / [Accept] this immaculate floral fragrance for the increase of life and health!

175.s:
daśāṅgaṃ guggulughṛtayuktaṃ dhūpaṃ gṛhāṇa vai /
sadhūpa dhūpita māṃ tvaṃ kuru dhūpitasatpate //
:n
1 vrate deva iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 197
175.d:
दशाङ्गं गुग्गुलुघृतयुक्तं धूपं गृहाण वै /
सधूप धूपित मां त्वं कुरु धूपितसत्पते //
:न्
1 व्रते देव इति ग.. , घ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
:प् 197
175.m:
Accept this incense of ten ingredients, accompanied by bdellium and clarified butter! / O true Lord perfumed with incense, make me fragrant with incense!"
[Footnote]
1. "vrate deva" in ga, gha, ja, jha, ña, and ṭa. / Page 197.

175.s:
dīpamūrdhaśikhaṃ dīptaṃ gṛhāṇākhilabhāsakaṃ /
dīpamūrte prakāśāḍhyaṃ sarvadordhvagatiṃ kuru //
175.d:
दीपमूर्धशिखं दीप्तं गृहाणाखिलभासकं /
दीपमूर्ते प्रकाशाढ्यं सर्वदोर्ध्वगतिं कुरु //
175.m: "Accept this radiant lamp whose flame rises upward, the illuminator of all! / O icon of light, rich in radiance, grant me an ever-upward path!

175.s:
annādikañca naivedyaṃ gṛhāṇānnādi satpate /
annādipūrṇaṃ kuru māmannadaṃ sarvadāyakaṃ //
175.d:
अन्नादिकञ्च नैवेद्यं गृहाणान्नादि सत्पते /
अन्नादिपूर्णं कुरु मामन्नदं सर्वदायकं //
175.m: O true Lord of food and all else, accept the food offering consisting of cooked grain and other items; / make me full of food and goods, a giver of food, a bestower of all!

175.s:
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ mayā prabho /
yat pūjitaṃ vratapate paripūrṇantadasu me //
175.d:
मन्त्रहीनं क्रियाहीनं भक्तिहीनं मया प्रभो /
यत् पूजितं व्रतपते परिपूर्णन्तदसु मे //
175.m: Whatever has been worshipped by me, O Lord, deficient in mantra, deficient in ritual, / or deficient in devotion, O Lord of vows, may that be completely fulfilled for me!

175.s:
dharmaṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ guṇasantatiṃ /
kīrtiṃ vidyāṃ(1) dehi cāyuḥ svargaṃ mokṣañca dehi me ///
175.d:
धर्मं देहि धनं देहि सौभाग्यं गुणसन्ततिं /
कीर्तिं विद्यां(1) देहि चायुः स्वर्गं मोक्षञ्च देहि मे ///
175.m: Grant me righteousness, grant me wealth, good fortune, an abundance of virtues, / fame, learning, long life, heaven, and liberation!"

175.s:
imāṃ pūjāṃ vratapate gṛhītvā vraja sāmprataṃ /
punarāgamanāyaiva varadānāya vai prabho //
175.d:
इमां पूजां व्रतपते गृहीत्वा व्रज साम्प्रतं /
पुनरागमनायैव वरदानाय वै प्रभो //
175.m: "Having accepted this worship, O Lord of vows, depart now, / only to return again, O Lord, to bestow boons!"

175.s:
snātvā vratavatā sarvavrateṣu vratamūrtayaḥ /
pūjyāḥ suvarṇajāstā vai śaktyā vai bhūmiśāyinā //
175.d:
स्नात्वा व्रतवता सर्वव्रतेषु व्रतमूर्तयः /
पूज्याः सुवर्णजास्ता वै शक्त्या वै भूमिशायिना //
175.m: Having bathed, the observer of vows must worship icons of the votive observance in all votive observances— / those made of gold according to one's capacity—while sleeping on the ground.

175.s:
japo homaś ca sāmānyavratānte dānameva ca /
caturviṃśā dvādaśa vā pañca vā traya ekakaḥ //
175.d:
जपो होमश् च सामान्यव्रतान्ते दानमेव च /
चतुर्विंशा द्वादश वा पञ्च वा त्रय एककः //
175.m: Recitation and fire oblation are common [to all], and gift-giving at the end of a votive observance. / Twenty-four, twelve, five, three, or one

175.s:
viprāḥ prapūjyā guravo(2) bhojyāḥ śaktyā tu dakṣiṇā /
deyā gāvaḥ suvarṇādyāḥ pādukopānahau pṛthak //
175.d:
विप्राः प्रपूज्या गुरवो(2) भोज्याः शक्त्या तु दक्षिणा /
देया गावः सुवर्णाद्याः पादुकोपानहौ पृथक् //
175.m: learned brāhmaṇas are to be worshipped, gurus are to be fed, and a sacrificial fee is to be given according to capacity: / cows, gold, and other gifts, as well as wooden sandals and leather shoes separately,

175.s:
jalapātrañcānnapātramṛttikācchatramāsanaṃ(3) /
śayyā vastrayugaṃ kumbhāḥ paribhāṣeyamīritā //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe vrataparibhāṣānāma
pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 kīrtiṃ vṛddhimiti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 viprāḥ pūjyāḥ sagarava iti gha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca
3 mudrikāchatramāsanamiti gha..
:p 198
:ś atha ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
pratipadvratāni
175.d:
जलपात्रञ्चान्नपात्रमृत्तिकाच्छत्रमासनं(3) /
शय्या वस्त्रयुगं कुम्भाः परिभाषेयमीरिता //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे व्रतपरिभाषानाम
पञ्चसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 कीर्तिं वृद्धिमिति ख.. , छ.. च
2 विप्राः पूज्याः सगरव इति घ.. , ज.. , ट.. च
3 मुद्रिकाछत्रमासनमिति घ..
:प् 198
:श् अथ षट्सप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रतिपद्व्रतानि
175.m:
a water vessel, a food dish, an earthen pot, an umbrella, a seat, / a bed, a pair of cloths, and water jars—this general rule has been declared.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-fifth chapter, named "General Rules for Votive Observances," in the great Agni Purāṇa.
[Footnote]
1. "kīrtiṃ vṛddhim" in kha and cha. / 2. "viprāḥ pūjyāḥ sagarava" in gha, ja, and ṭa.
[…] [text missing or variant] / [Page 198]
Now, the one hundred and seventy-sixth chapter.
Votive observances of the first lunar day.

176.s:
agnir uvāca
vakṣye pratipadādīni vratānyakhiladāni te /
kārttikāśvayuje caitre pratipadbrahmaṇastithiḥ //
176.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
वक्ष्ये प्रतिपदादीनि व्रतान्यखिलदानि ते /
कार्त्तिकाश्वयुजे चैत्रे प्रतिपद्ब्रह्मणस्तिथिः //
176.m: Agni said: / I shall declare to you the votive observances of the first lunar day and others, which grant all desires. / In Kārttika, Āśvayuja, and Caitra, the first lunar day is the lunar day of Brahmā.

176.s:
pañcadaśyānnirāhāraḥ pratipadyarcayedajaṃ /
oṃ tat sadbrahmaṇe namo gāyatryā vāvdamekakaṃ //
176.d:
पञ्चदश्यान्निराहारः प्रतिपद्यर्चयेदजं /
ओं तत् सद्ब्रह्मणे नमो गायत्र्या वाव्दमेककं //
176.m: Fasting on the fifteenth day, one should worship the Unborn on the first lunar day / with "Om, tat sat, reverence to Brahmā," or with the Gāyatrī, for one year.

176.s:
akṣamālāśruvandakṣe(1) vāme śrucakamaṇḍalu(2) /
lambakūrcañca jaṭilaṃ haimaṃ brahmāṇamarcayet //
176.d:
अक्षमालाश्रुवन्दक्षे(1) वामे श्रुचकमण्डलु(2) /
लम्बकूर्चञ्च जटिलं हैमं ब्रह्माणमर्चयेत् //
176.m: With a rosary and a small offering ladle in his right hands, and a large offering ladle and a water pot in his left, / with a long beard and matted hair—one should worship golden Brahmā.

176.s:
śaktyā kṣīraṃ pradadyāttu brahmā me prīyatāmiti /
nirmalo bhogabhk svarge bhūmau vipro dhanī bhavet //
176.d:
शक्त्या क्षीरं प्रदद्यात्तु ब्रह्मा मे प्रीयतामिति /
निर्मलो भोगभ्क् स्वर्गे भूमौ विप्रो धनी भवेत् //
176.m: According to one's capacity one should offer milk, praying, "May Brahmā be pleased with me!" / Free from stain, he enjoys pleasures in heaven, and on earth he becomes a wealthy brāhmaṇa.

176.s:
dhanyaṃ vrataṃ pravakṣyāmi adhanyo dhanyatāṃ vrajet /
mārgaśīrṣe pratipadi naktaṃ hutvā pyupoṣitaḥ(3) //
176.d:
धन्यं व्रतं प्रवक्ष्यामि अधन्यो धन्यतां व्रजेत् /
मार्गशीर्षे प्रतिपदि नक्तं हुत्वा प्युपोषितः(3) //
176.m: I shall proclaim the Dhanya-vrata; by it the unfortunate becomes fortunate. / On the first lunar day of Mārgaśīrṣa, fasting and having offered oblations at night,

176.s:
agnaye nama ity agniṃ prārcyāvdaṃ sarvabhāg bhavet /
pratipadyekabhaktāśī samāpte kapilāpradaḥ //
176.d:
अग्नये नम इत्य् अग्निं प्रार्च्याव्दं सर्वभाग् भवेत् /
प्रतिपद्येकभक्ताशी समाप्ते कपिलाप्रदः //
176.m: having worshipped Agni for a year with "Reverence to Agni," one becomes an enjoyer of all things. / Eating only once a day on the first lunar day, upon its completion he gives a brown cow.

176.s:
vaiśvānarapadaṃ yāti śikhivratamidaṃ smṛtaṃ /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe pratipadvratāni nāma
ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 akṣamālāśrucaṃ dakṣe iti cha..
2 vāme daṇḍakamaṇḍalu iti cha.. , jha.. / vāme śruvakamaṇḍalu iti
cha..
3 naktaṃ kṛccābhyupoṣita iti ga..
:p 199
:ś atha saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvitīyāvratāni
176.d:
वैश्वानरपदं याति शिखिव्रतमिदं स्मृतं /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रतिपद्व्रतानि नाम
षट्सप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 अक्षमालाश्रुचं दक्षे इति छ..
2 वामे दण्डकमण्डलु इति छ.. , झ.. / वामे श्रुवकमण्डलु इति
छ..
3 नक्तं कृच्चाभ्युपोषित इति ग..
:प् 199
:श् अथ सप्तसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
द्वितीयाव्रतानि
176.m:
He goes to the realm of Vaiśvānara; this is known as the Śikhi-vrata.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-sixth chapter, named "Votive Observances of the First Lunar Day," in the great Agni Purāṇa.
[Footnote]
1. "akṣamālāśrucaṃ dakṣe" in cha.
2. "vāme daṇḍakamaṇḍalu" in cha and jha; "vāme śruvakamaṇḍalu" in cha.
3. "naktaṃ kṛccābhyupoṣita" in ga. / Page 199.
Now, the one hundred and seventy-seventh chapter.
Votive observances of the second lunar day.

177.s:
agnir uvāca
dvitīyāvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktidāyakaṃ /
puṣpāhārī dvitīyāyāmaśvinau pūjayet surau //
177.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
द्वितीयाव्रतकं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिदायकं /
पुष्पाहारी द्वितीयायामश्विनौ पूजयेत् सुरौ //
177.m: Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of the second lunar day, which bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation. / Subsisting on flowers on the second lunar day, one should worship the two gods, the Aśvins,

177.s:
abdaṃ svarūpasaubhāgyaṃ svargabhāg jāyate vratī /
kārttike śuktipakṣasya(1) ditīyāyāṃ yamaṃ yajet //
177.d:
अब्दं स्वरूपसौभाग्यं स्वर्गभाग् जायते व्रती /
कार्त्तिके शुक्तिपक्षस्य(1) दितीयायां यमं यजेत् //
177.m: for a year; the observer of the vow obtains beauty and good fortune, and partakes of heaven. / On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Kārttika, one should worship Yama;

177.s:
abdamupoṣitaḥ svargaṃ gacchenna narakaṃ vratī /
aśūnyaśayanaṃ vakṣye avaidhavyādidāyakaṃ //
177.d:
अब्दमुपोषितः स्वर्गं गच्छेन्न नरकं व्रती /
अशून्यशयनं वक्ष्ये अवैधव्यादिदायकं //
177.m: having fasted [on this day] for a year, the observer of the vow goes to heaven and does not enter hell. / I shall declare the Aśūnyaśayana [vow], which averts widowhood and brings other benefits.

177.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇāsya caredidaṃ /
śrīvatsadhārin śrikānta śrīdhāman śrīpate 'vyaya //
177.d:
कृष्णपक्षे द्वितीयायां श्रावणास्य चरेदिदं /
श्रीवत्सधारिन् श्रिकान्त श्रीधामन् श्रीपते ऽव्यय //
177.m: One should perform this on the second lunar day of the dark fortnight of Śrāvaṇa: / "O bearer of the Śrīvatsa, O beloved of Śrī, O abode of Śrī, O Lord of Śrī, O imperishable one!

177.s:
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadaṃ /
agnayī mā praṇaśyantu mā praṇaśyantu devatāḥ //
177.d:
गार्हस्थ्यं मा प्रणाशं मे यातु धर्मार्थकामदं /
अग्नयी मा प्रणश्यन्तु मा प्रणश्यन्तु देवताः //
177.m: May my householder life, which bestows righteousness, wealth, and desire, not perish! / May my fires not perish! May my deities not perish!"

177.s:
pitaro mā praṇaśyantu matto dāmpatyabhedataḥ /
lakṣmyā viyujyate devo na kadāśidyathā bhavān //
177.d:
पितरो मा प्रणश्यन्तु मत्तो दाम्पत्यभेदतः /
लक्ष्म्या वियुज्यते देवो न कदाशिद्यथा भवान् //
177.m: May the ancestors not perish away from me through marital discord. / Just as You, O God, are never separated from Lakṣmī,

177.s:
tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me vibhidyatāṃ /
lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ vibho //
177.d:
तथा कलत्रसम्बन्धो देव मा मे विभिद्यतां /
लक्ष्म्या न शून्यं वरद यथा ते शयनं विभो //
177.m: so too, O God, may my marital union not be broken. / Just as Your bed is never devoid of Lakṣmī, O boon-giver, O All-pervading One,

177.s:
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathaiva madhusūdana /
lakṣmīṃ viṣṇuṃ yajedavdaṃ dadyācchayyāṃ phalāni ca //
177.d:
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथैव मधुसूदन /
लक्ष्मीं विष्णुं यजेदव्दं दद्याच्छय्यां फलानि च //
177.m: so also may my bed not be empty, O Madhusūdana! / One should worship Lakṣmī and Viṣṇu for a year, and give a bed and fruits,

177.s:
pratimāsaṃ ca somāya dadyādarghyaṃ samantrakaṃ /
:n
1 śuktapakṣe tu iti ga..
:p 200
gaganāṅgaṇasandīpa dugdhābdhimathanodbhava //
177.d:
प्रतिमासं च सोमाय दद्यादर्घ्यं समन्त्रकं /
:न्
1 शुक्तपक्षे तु इति ग..
:प् 200
गगनाङ्गणसन्दीप दुग्धाब्धिमथनोद्भव //
177.m:
and each month offer a water offering accompanied by mantras to Soma:
:n
1 'śuklapakṣe tu' thus in manuscript ga. / :p 200
‘O Illuminator of the courtyard of the sky! O One born from the churning of the milk ocean!

177.s:
bhābhāsitādigābhoga rāmānuja namo 'stu te /
oṃ śrīṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ somātmānaṃ hariṃ yajet //
177.d:
भाभासितादिगाभोग रामानुज नमो ऽस्तु ते /
ओं श्रीं श्रीधराय नमः सोमात्मानं हरिं यजेत् //
177.m: O You whose brilliance illumines the expanse of the directions! O younger brother of Rāma, salutation to You!’ / ‘Om Śrīm, salutation to Śrīdhara.’ One should worship Hari as the embodiment of Soma,

177.s:
ghaṃ ḍhaṃ bhaṃ haṃ śriyai namo daśarūpamahātmane /
ghṛtena homo naktañca śayyāṃ dadyāddvijātaye(1) //
177.d:
घं ढं भं हं श्रियै नमो दशरूपमहात्मने /
घृतेन होमो नक्तञ्च शय्यां दद्याद्द्विजातये(1) //
177.m: ‘Gham dham bham ham, salutation to Śrī, to the Great-souled One possessing ten forms.’ / A fire oblation should be made with ghee, [food taken] at night, and one should give a bed to a twice-born,

177.s:
dīpānnabhājanair yuktaṃ chatropānahamāsanaṃ /
sodakumbhañca pratimāṃ viprāyātha ca pātrakaṃ(2) //
177.d:
दीपान्नभाजनैर् युक्तं छत्रोपानहमासनं /
सोदकुम्भञ्च प्रतिमां विप्रायाथ च पात्रकं(2) //
177.m: equipped with lamps, vessels of food, an umbrella, shoes, and a seat, / along with a water-pot, an image, and a drinking vessel to the Brahmin.

177.s:
patnyā ya evaṃ kurute bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
kāntivrataṃ pravakṣyāmi kārttikasya site caret //
177.d:
पत्न्या य एवं कुरुते भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
कान्तिव्रतं प्रवक्ष्यामि कार्त्तिकस्य सिते चरेत् //
177.m: Whoever performs this along with his wife attains worldly enjoyment and liberation. / I shall now declare the Kāntivrata; one should observe it in the bright [fortnight] of Kārttika.

177.s:
naktabhojī dvitīyāyāṃ pūjayed balakeśavau /
varṣaṃ prāpnoti vai kāntimāyurārogyakādikaṃ //
177.d:
नक्तभोजी द्वितीयायां पूजयेद् बलकेशवौ /
वर्षं प्राप्नोति वै कान्तिमायुरारोग्यकादिकं //
177.m: Eating at night on the second lunar day, one should worship Balarāma and Keśava; / for a year [one does this and] obtains beauty, longevity, good health, and the like.

177.s:
atha śiṣṇuvrataṃ vakṣye manovāñchitadāyakaṃ /
pauṣaśukladvitīyādi kṛtvā dinacatuṣṭayaṃ //
177.d:
अथ शिष्णुव्रतं वक्ष्ये मनोवाञ्छितदायकं /
पौषशुक्लद्वितीयादि कृत्वा दिनचतुष्टयं //
177.m: Now I will declare the Viṣṇuvrata, which grants the desires of the mind: / having observed it for four days beginning from the bright second lunar day of Pauṣa,

177.s:
pūrvaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ(3)smṛtaṃ /
vacayā ca tṛtīye 'hni sarvauṣadhyā caturthake //
177.d:
पूर्वं सिद्धार्थकैः स्नानं ततः कृष्णतिलैः(3)स्मृतं /
वचया च तृतीये ऽह्नि सर्वौषध्या चतुर्थके //
177.m: first a bath with white mustard seeds is prescribed, then with black sesame seeds, / with sweet flag on the third day, and with all-herbs on the fourth.

177.s:
murāmāṃṣī vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śaileyaṃ rajanīdvarya(4) /
saṭī campakamustañca sarvauṣadhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ //
177.d:
मुरामांषी वचा कुष्ठं शैलेयं रजनीद्वर्य(4) /
सटी चम्पकमुस्तञ्च सर्वौषधिगणः स्मृतः //
177.m: Murā, jaṭāmāṃsī, sweet flag, kuṣṭha, lichen, the two turmerics, / saṭī, campaka, and mustā are known as the group of all-herbs.

177.s:
nāmnā kṛṣṇācyutānanta hṛṣīkeśeti pūjayet /
pāde nābhyāṃ cakṣuṣi ca kramācchirasi puṣpakaiḥ //
177.d:
नाम्ना कृष्णाच्युतानन्त हृषीकेशेति पूजयेत् /
पादे नाभ्यां चक्षुषि च क्रमाच्छिरसि पुष्पकैः //
177.m: One should worship Him with the names: ‘O Kṛṣṇa, Acyuta, Ananta, Hṛṣīkeśa!’ / on His feet, navel, eyes, and head, respectively, with flowers;

177.s:
śaśicandraśaśāṅkendusañjñābhiścārghyaṃ indave /
naktaṃ bhuñjīta ca naro yāvattiṣṭhati candramāḥ //
:n
1 śayyāṃ dadyāddvitīyake iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ,
ṭa.. ca
2 viprāyātha ca pānakamiti gha.. , ña.. ca
3 śuktatilair iti ga..
4 pūrvaṃ siddhārthakair ityādiḥ, rajanīdvayamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ
jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 201
177.d:
शशिचन्द्रशशाङ्केन्दुसञ्ज्ञाभिश्चार्घ्यं इन्दवे /
नक्तं भुञ्जीत च नरो यावत्तिष्ठति चन्द्रमाः //
:न्
1 शय्यां दद्याद्द्वितीयके इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. ,
ट.. च
2 विप्रायाथ च पानकमिति घ.. , ञ.. च
3 शुक्ततिलैर् इति ग..
4 पूर्वं सिद्धार्थकैर् इत्यादिः, रजनीद्वयमित्यन्तः पाठः
झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 201
177.m:
and [present] a water offering to the Moon with the names Śaśin, Candra, Śaśāṅka, and Indu. / A person should eat at night as long as the moon remains [in the sky].
:n
1 'śayyāṃ dadyāddvitīyake' thus in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, ja, ña, and ṭa.
2 'viprāyātha ca pānakam' thus in manuscripts gha and ña.
3 'śuklatilair' thus in manuscript ga.
4 The text from 'pūrvaṃ siddhārthakair' up to 'rajanīdvayam' is missing in manuscript jha. / :p 201

177.s:
ṣaṇmāsaṃ pāvanaṃ cābdaṃ prāpnuyāt sakalaṃ vratī /
etad vrataṃ nṛpaiḥ strībhiḥ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ surādibhiḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe dvitīyāvratāni nāma
saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
tṛtīyāvratāni
177.d:
षण्मासं पावनं चाब्दं प्राप्नुयात् सकलं व्रती /
एतद् व्रतं नृपैः स्त्रीभिः कृतं पूर्वं सुरादिभिः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे द्वितीयाव्रतानि नाम
सप्तसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
तृतीयाव्रतानि
177.m:
The observer of the votive observance attains purificatory [merit] for six months and a full year. / This votive observance was formerly performed by kings, women, and the gods.
:e Thus in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and seventy-seventh chapter, entitled 'The Votive Observances of the Second Lunar Day'.
:ś Now the one hundred and seventy-eighth chapter:
The Votive Observances of the Third Lunar Day
